transliteration: me-er-ú a-mur-IŠTAR ú me-er-at a-mur-IŠTAR gu₅-ba-áb-tum me-er-ú pu-šu-ke-en₆ ú DUMU.SAL pu-šu-ke-en₆ gu₅-ba-áb-tum a-ḫu-um a-na a-ḫi-im a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu lá i-tù-ar
translation: Die Söhne des Āmurištar und die Tochter des Āmurištar, die gubabtum-Priesterin, die Söhne des Pūšukēn und die Tochter des Pūšukēn, die gubabtum-Priesterin: Die eine (Partei) wird auf die andere in irgendeiner Sache nicht zurckkommen.

translation: Diese Leute (waren) die Beender der Rechtssachen.

translation: The silver that her mother left to her daughter as part of the outstanding claims, do you want to take it for the debt, for her brothers?

transliteration: ni-zi-iz-ma i-na a-wa-tim ni-bu-šu-nu-ma iš-tù gám-ru-um
translation: We took action and rebutted them by our argumentation.

translation: In the packet of silver 2 1/4 shekels of silver of Iliya, excise for Aššur, have been put.

translation: This silver was in Elamma's house.

transliteration: 2 ṣí-il₅-a-nu ša ṭup-pé-e ku-nu-ku ša a-ḥe-ki ù um-mì-ki i-ba-ší-ú
translation: There are still two containers with tablets sealed by your brothers and mother.

transliteration: pá-al-ḥa-ni-ma pá-ṭá-ra-am ú-lá ni-mu-wa

transliteration: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ma-dí-im mì-ma lá ta-da-gi₅-li
translation: Do by no means expect much silver,

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR a-mì-um ù KI-kam um-mì-ki
translation: there is only the afore-mentioned silver and the seal of your mother.

translation: Unabi and Ašiat owe 15 minas of washed copper, weighed with our stones, to Luzi.

translation: Reckoned from the week of Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-nādā they must pay within 4 weeks.

translation: If they have not paid in time, they must add interest according to the rule of the colony.

translation: They must pay the copper in Purušhaddum.

translation: Month Hubur, eponymy Iddin-abum.

transliteration: IGI i-dí-a-bi4-im DUMU i-tur4-DINGIR
translation: Witnessed by Iddin-abum son of Itūr-ilī.

transliteration: a-na a-lá-ḥi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
translation: To Ali-ahum from Zukuwa:

transliteration: lá-ma a-li-kà-ni AN.NA-kà ta-dí-in
translation: Before I came your tin was sold.

transliteration: šu-qú-ul-tí AN.NA-ki-kà 1 GÚ 30 ma-na 0.5 ma-na mu-ṭá-e i-šku-nu
translation: The weight of your tin was 1 talent 30 minas; 0.5 mina they established as losses.

translation: I questioned your representatives, saying: "How did you sell the tin?"

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma 8 LÁ 22.5 ŠE GÍN.TA ta-dí-in
translation: They answered: "It was sold at the rate 8 minus 22.5 grains."

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ṣa-ba-at-ma 11.33333 ma-na 2 GÍN ší-tí an-ni-ki-kà
translation: Seize the silver, 11 1/3 minas 2 shekels was the rest for your tin.

transliteration: lá-ma a-li-kà-ni KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-áš-qú-ul
translation: Before I arrived you had not been paid the silver;

transliteration: iš-tù u4-mì-im ša a-li-kà-ni KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma KÙ.BABBAR i ku-nu-ki-ni i-ba-ší
translation: the day I arrived I had the silver paid and the silver is under our seals.

transliteration: ki-ma i-na a-li-ki DUMU um-me-a-nim ša KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na na-áš-ú lá-šu-ma a ší-a-tí KÙ.BABBAR ni-ik-lá
translation: Since there is no affiliated trader among the travellers who can be responsible for some 10 minas of silver, for that reason we held the silver back.

transliteration: li-ba-kà mì-ma lá tù-la-ma-an
translation: Do not get angry.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR na-dí
translation: The silver is ready.

transliteration: a-dí 5 u4-me-e šu-ḥu-bur wa-ṣa-a-am qá-bi
translation: Within 5 days Šu-Hubur has promised to leave.

transliteration: iš-tí šu-ḥu-bur KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà nu-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: We shall send you your silver with Šu-Hubur.

translation: I made Šukkutum pay 4 minas of silver from what was in his certified tablet.

translation: Total of your silver, from the proceeds of the tin and from Šukkutum, in all Šu-Hubur will bring you 15 minas 11 shekels under our seals.

transliteration: um-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ma a-na a-li-ki qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus the Kanesh colony, say to the travelers:

translation: Here Suen-damiq has appealed to us and he said:

translation: "I want Liptānum, son of Qardaya, to be brought back; I take responsibility for bringing him back".

transliteration: DU10-ṣí-lá-a-šùr ší-pár-ni
translation: Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur is our messenger.

transliteration: iš-tí DU10-ṣí-lá-a-šùr li-tù-ra-am
translation: He must come back with Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur.

transliteration: a-tù-nu lu e-mu-uq-šu
translation: You must be his executive force.

translation: To Ilī-emūqī, Šu-Tammuzi, Abiya, Elaya and Lamassī from Adida and Ali-ahum:

translation: After Šalim-Aššur died, our father's customers to whom he owed silver there treated me and Ennam-Aššur badly, we were detained and our outstanding claims blocked, and you heard about it and went to the City assembly, and the City gave a verdict as follows:

transliteration: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-a-šur i-na eq-lim ha-bu-ul i-na tup-pì-šu ù ší-bi4-šu i-ku-an-ma i-na sá-bi-tí-šu KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu i-lá-qé
translation: if Šalim-Aššur owed silver abroad, it must be proved with his tablet and witnesses and he (the creditor) may then receive his silver from the funds available;

transliteration: a-na hu-bu-ul ša-lim-a-šur ša i-na a-lim(ki) ha-bu-lu ma-ma-an KÙ.BABBAR i-na eq-lim lá i-lá-qé
translation: as for the debt that Šalim-Aššur owed in the City, noone could take any silver abroad.

transliteration: ma-ma-an ša il₅-qé-ú ú-ta-ar
translation: Whoever took any would have to return it;

transliteration: ša lá ú-ta-e-ru i-ša-ri-iq-šum
translation: who did not return it would have it taken away by force.

transliteration: …-me-er … … …-ku-nim-ma … … šu a-lam ha x lu … li-mu-um ni-ta šu ma mì … ša-lim-a-šur 3 x x x x x x x i-za-zu a-na a-lim x ta-lí-kà-ni
translation: ... the eponym ... Šalim-Aššur ... they will stand ... To the City ... when you went to the City...

transliteration: me-eḥ-ra-at tup-pì-im ša a-lim(ki) a-ba-ba ra-bi4-ṣú-um ub-lá-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša ṣa-bu-tù ú-šé-ru-ma sí-ki-ni ú-kà
translation: Ababa, the attorney brought a copy of the tablet of the City and they released all the silver that had been confiscated, but they detained us.

translation: 2 talents 10 minas of sealed tin, 52 good textiles, 3 black donkeys, sealed by Aššur-bāni and Bēlum-bāni and belonging to a merchant, they entrusted to Puzur-A...

translation: You have taken the spoon with which they anointed you with oil.

translation: The spoon is not worth 0.5 shekel of copper,

translation: but I became upset as if it was worth 10 or 20 shekels of silver.

translation: Give it to Uṣur-ša-Ištar there so he can give it to the maid.

translation: If you have not give it, I shall be upset.

transliteration: a-na 5-ší-šu šé-né-en na-áš-ú-ni-kum
translation: ... they bring you for 5 pairs of shoes.

transliteration: šu-be-lam tùr-dam
translation: Send me Šu-Bēlum.

transliteration: 4 GÚ AN.NA ù it-ra-sú ku-nu-ki ša a-lim(ki)
translation: 4 talents of tin plus its extras, sealed in the City,

transliteration: 20 ku-ta-ni qá-dum 12 ku-ta-ni ma-ṭí-ú-tim ša li-wi-tim a-ha-ma 20 ku-ta-ni qá-tám ša e-kál-lúm a-na ší-mì-im il₅-qé-ú a-na qá-tí ša-lim-a-šùr ṭá-ah-ú
translation: 20 textiles including 12 of low quality for wrapping, further, 20 textiles, the share that the palace took for pre-emption, have been transferred to Šalim-Aššur's account -

translation: in all Šalim-Aššur has received 40 textiles and 5 black donkeys from the merchandise that arrived with Šu-Kūbum's transport.

translation: The rest of his textiles, 45 including his textiles of good quality, are in Šalim-Aššur's house under Šu-Kūbum's seal.

transliteration: 3 ku-ta-ni ni-is-ha-tim e-kál-lúm il₅-qé
translation: The palace received 3 textiles as import duty;

transliteration: 3 ku-ta-ni ša li-wi-tim SIG₅ e-kál-lúm il₅-qé ù 2 ku-ta-nu i-na e-kál-lim iḥ-li-qú
translation: the palace received 3 from the wrapping of good quality, and 2 were lost in the palace.

translation: Šu-Kūbum has paid 15 minas of tin on top of his expense tin as balance to Šalim-Aššur.

translation: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Puzur-Anna son of Iddin-Adad.

translation: To Šalim-Aššur from Šu-Tammuzi, Adida, Elaya and Lamassī:

transliteration: i-na wa-ṣa-i-kà … um-ma a-ta-ma a-šùr-DU10 DUMU lu-lu KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na
translation: When you left ... you said: Lulu's son Aššur-ṭāb ... at least 10 minas of silver ...

transliteration: iš-ra-tí-šu ru-ba-um i-lá-qé
translation: the king will receive its / his tithe.

translation: Later the man went to the City assembly and said: "He gave it to me for purchases."

transliteration: qí-ip-tám a-dí 5 ša-na-tim qé-pá-ku
translation: "I was entrusted with a credit for 5 years."

translation: He asked for a favour from the City assembly, and his representative will set his terms for a year and ... his representative ... whether you entrusted on credit ...

translation: To Ennam-Aššur from Lā-qēp: Ennānum and I entered your storeroom and

translation: brought out your tablets and your bronze (objects) and left them in Itūr-ilī's house.

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú 3 GÍN 22.5 ŠE KÙ.GI ša iš-tù kà-tí-lá e-ra-mu-ša ub-lá-ni
translation: 1.5 mina of silver and 3 shekels 22.5 grains of gold that Ewarimuša brought from Katila

transliteration: i-na qá-qí-dim ša a-bi4-kà en-na-aḥ-ì-lí ú a-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà ni-x-ma 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-il₅-pu-ut
translation: from the capital of your father Enah-ilī, also for the silver under your seal, we have ... and we have booked 1.5 mina of silver.

translation: I shall realise every mina of silver on the tin here for him.

transliteration: mì-ma ba-áb-tám i É-tim lá i-ba-ší-ú

translation: Urgent: (turn) the assets of your father into silver.

translation: you have treated me badly.

translation: You have seized ... As for me, my lord is consuming me like bread.

transliteration: ki-ma a-ma-kam tù-ša-zi-zi-ni um-ma a-ta-ma ší-im am-tim a-na me-er-i-a lá ta-dí-ni
translation: As you instructed me there, saying: 'You must not give the price of the slave-girl to my son!'

translation: Send me the price of the copper and the outstanding silver for which I made the native responsible to you and send me a message then I will give your slave-girl to your representative.

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-li-li ù kà-ar-ší-ni wa-al-dí-lúm ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí i-šu-ú
translation: Alili and Karšini owe 1 mina of silver to Waldi-ilum and Ištar-lamassī.

transliteration: a-na ša tù-ùh-tù-ha-nim 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 UDU.HI.A i-du-nu
translation: They will give 1.5 mina of silver plus 2 sheep for the feast of Tuhtuhānum.

transliteration: IGI bé-li-kà-ù bé-el-tí-kà
translation: Before your lord and your lady.

transliteration: IGI wa-al-dí-lim ù kà-ar-ni-kà-šu
translation: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum and Karnikašu.

transliteration: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma (d)IM.GAL-ma
translation: To Šalim-Aššur from Adad-rabi:

transliteration: a-na ṭup-pí a-šu-mì i-dí-a-bi-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni a-šùr-ma-lik ù ša-lim-a-šur áš-al-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma
translation: As to the tablets concerning Iddin-abum that you wrote to me about - I asked Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur, saying:

transliteration: i-nu-mì i-sú-ri-ik a-wa-tim ša i-dí-a-bi-im iš-tí me-ra-ni iš-tí GUDU4 ša IŠTAR ù É za-ak-ta-a ù a-li ta-ad-mì-iq-tám i-dí-nu-šù-ni a-wa-tim ig-mu-ru
translation: When Issu-arik cleared up Iddin-abum's affairs with Merani, with the priest of Ištar and Zaktaya's firm, and where he gave him a free loan, at that time they finished the matters.

transliteration: i-nu-mì-šù-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša ša-qá-lim iš-qú-ul ù ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pí-šu ú-ha-ri-mu ša i-dí-a-bu-um ha-bu-lu-ma šál-ma-a-šùr qá-ta-tù-ni
translation: At that time he paid the silver for paying, but did they certify his tablets for the rest of the silver, stating that Iddin-abum owed it, and that Šalim-Aššur was the guarantor?

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭup-pu-um šu-um-šu ú-lá ha-ri-im
translation: They answered: 'No tablet at all was certified.'

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi-lam-ma a-na a-wi-li ni-iš-qú-ul
translation: He sent us the silver and we paid the men.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma ke-na i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-ah-ri-ni e-ta-wu-šù-um
translation: They continued: 'It is true that Issu-arik discussed with him in our presence.'

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma ha-bu-ul a-hi-kà lu a-na-kam lu i-na GÁN-lim šu-qú-ul-ma ù a-lik-ma i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-hi-kà le-qé
translation: He said: 'Pay the debt of your brother, both here and abroad, and then go and take it again out of your brother's silver.'

transliteration: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-hi-kà lá-šu i-na na-ru-qí-kà šu-qúl
translation: If there is no silver belonging to your brother, then pay out of your joint-stock capital.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ša i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-ah-ri-šù-nu e-ta-wu-ku-ni ú-šé-ra-sú-nu-ma KÁ DINGIR ṭup-pá-áš-nu a-lá-q
translation: For these words which Issu-arik discussed with you in their presence I shall lead them off, and I shall receive their tablet in the Gate of the God.

transliteration: 1 ku-ta-num 2 šu-re-en₆ ša šu-ku-bi-im a-na 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-bu-ru-uš-ha-tim ta-ad-nu
translation: 1 kutānum (and) 2 dark textiles belonging to Šu-Kūbum have been sold in Burušhattum for 0.6666 mina of silver.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA ša 25 ma-na URUDU KÙ-áp-šu a šu-mì šu-ku-bi4-im ú-ṣa-hi-ru
translation: From it they deducted the silver equivalent of 25 minas of copper for Šu-Kūbum's account.

transliteration: ša 15 ma-na URUDU a šu-mì-a ú-ṣa-hi-ru
translation: And they deducted that of 15 minas of copper for my account.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-šu 14 GÍN
translation: The rest of his silver is 14 shekels.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na kà-ni-iš ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in
translation: Thereof: 10 shekels of silver Šalim-ahum gave in Kanesh.

transliteration: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku a-na-pá-al
translation: I myself will pay 4 shekels of silver.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-pu-ul-šum
translation: Of this amount you paid him 28 shekels of silver.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ i-tu-me-li-a a-dí-šum
translation: 2 shekels of silver I gave him in Tumeliya.

transliteration: 1.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-kúl-tí ANŠE ù da-a-sú ša a-dí wa-ah-šu-ša-na
translation: 1.6666 shekel of silver fodder for the donkey and road-tax for it until Wahšušana.

transliteration: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša 30 TÚG.HI.A iš-tù ú-lá-ma a-dí bu-ru-uš-ha-tim ù É wa-áb-ri
translation: 3 shekels of silver for 30 textiles from Ulama until Burušhattum and for the cost of the inn.

transliteration: 0.33333 ma-na 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ha-bi-a ù a-ší-tí-šu a-lā-hu-um i-šu
translation: Habiya and his wife owe 0.3333 mina 1.5 shekel of silver to Ali-ahum.

transliteration: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma ù kur-ub-IŠTAR-ma a-na da-da ù i-na-aḫ-DINGIR qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus Elamma and Kurub-Ištar, say to Dada and Ēnah-ilī:

transliteration: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša aḫ-ša-lim a-na a-bi-ku-nu ub-lá-ni šu-ma 15 GÍN.TA i-ba-ší AN.NA ša-ma-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: The 30 minas of silver that Ah-šalim brought to your father, if there is tin available at a rate of 15 shekels (to 1), then buy it and send it to me.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na 15 GÍN.TA ba-tí-iq mì-iš-lam AN.NA mì-iš-lam TÚG.ḪI.A ša-ma-ma i pá-ni-im-ma áb-kà-nim
translation: If the rate is less than 15 shekels (to 1) then buy for one half of it tin and for the other half textiles and ship them to me with the first opportunity.

transliteration: a-ni-ša-am a-ba-ra-im li-ik-šu-dam
translation: It should reach me here before the suspension of traffic.

transliteration: i-nu-mì AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A ta-kà-na-kà i pá-ni šu-uq-lá-tim ù sí-ke TÚG.ḪI.A ša DAM.GÀR lá-pí-ta-nim
translation: When you seal the tin and the textiles write on the packets (with tin) and on the hem of the textiles: "Belonging to the merchant".

transliteration: i ki-dim a-wa-at-ku-nu lá i-ša-me
translation: No word of you should be heard outside!

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša e-la-ma
translation: The silver belongs to Elamma.

transliteration: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 8.33333 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ iš-tù ni-mar-ZU ba zi ú ni i li-bi4 en-nam-a-šur DUMU (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni
translation: 12 shekels of silver plus 8.3333 minas of good copper I deposited with Ennam-Aššur son of Amurrum-bāni after Nimar-Sīn.

transliteration: a-dí šu-ma a-a-e-ma pu-uz-ra-am i-ṣa-ba-at 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ba-lu-um dí-nim ù ṣa-al-tim i-ša-qá-lam
translation: Until, if he takes refuge anywhere, he shall pay 1 mina of silver without lawsuit or litigation.

transliteration: IGI a-zu-a IGI ra-áb-a-šur DUMU a-šur-i-mí-tí
translation: Witnessed by Azua, witnessed by Rab-Aššur son of Aššur-imittī.

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur from Amur-Aššur:

transliteration: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR-kà ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni tap-pá-i KÙ.BABBAR uš-ta-pár-ki
translation: Concerning your silver that you wrote me about, my partner has allowed the silver to stop.

transliteration: a-dí ITU.1.KAM iš-tí-in x x x x-ni šu x x x-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: Within a single month ... I shall leave.

transliteration: ú u4-mu-a 2 ITU.KAM a-ḫu-ru
translation: Also, my term still runs for 2 months.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ki-iš-da-tí-a a-na i-dí-a-šùr DUMU dan-a-šùr i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-ul
translation: I myself paid 0.6666 mina 7.5 shekels of refined silver, my earnings, to Iddin-Aššur son of Dan-Aššur.

transliteration: lu a-na ri-ig-ma-tim i-dí-a-šur ir-dí-ni-a-tí-ni lu a-na ṭup-pí ša ší-bi4 i bá-áb DINGIR-lim ú-ga-ri-mu-ni 1 GÚ 40 ma-na ag-mu-ur-ma mì-iš-li-šu ṣí-li-a i-dín-nam
translation: I personally spent 1 talent 40 minas (of copper) both when Iddin-Aššur led us to the court case and when they produced the tablet with witnesses in the gate of the God, and Ṣilliya gave me half of that.

transliteration: x 0.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ mu-ṣí-šu ú pu-ru-sà-e ša ra-bi4-ṣí-im i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-ul
translation: I personally paid x 0.5 minas of good copper, the exit-tax and the decision of the attorney.

transliteration: ú-ku-ul-tí MAŠKIM a-na-ku-ma ú-ša-qí-il₅
translation: I too paid for the food of the attorney.

transliteration: ṣí-li-a mì-ma a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu ú-lá i-dín
translation: Ṣilliya did not give anything for his food.

transliteration: i-nu-mì a-na-ku ù a-ba-ba a-ṣé-er ì-lí-dan e-tí-qú-ni i-na ḫa-ra-nim lu a-dí u4-mì-im a-nim ni-is-ḫu-ru-ma a-wa-sú ni-ib-tù-qú-ni
translation: When I and Ababa travelled to Ilī-dan we were delayed on the journey until this very day, and we dropped his case;

transliteration: ú iš-tù ku-bu-ur-na-at a-dí dur4-ḫu-mì-it ni-tù-ru-ni 0.5 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ga-me-er
translation: then we returned from Kuburnat to Durhumit - 0.5 mina 4 shekels of silver was the expense.

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim a-dí a-wa-tim ša É a-bi-ni kà-šá-dim ú-ga-me-er
translation: All this I have paid in order to conclude the matter of our father's house.

transliteration: i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša É a-bi-a gám-ri a-lá-qé
translation: I shall take my expenses from the silver of my father's house.

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma sà-ba-sí-a ù tám-kà-ru-um-ma a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù zi-ki-ki qí-bi-ma
translation: From Šalim-Aššur, Sabasiya and the merchant to Pilah-Ištar and Zikiki:

transliteration: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša tám-kà-ri-im
translation: 30 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, belonging to a merchant;

transliteration: a-ḫa-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ik-ri-bu ša a-šur ša tám-kà-ri-ma ku-nu-ki-šu a-na ṣé-er ì-lí-iš-tí-kál ù pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR zi-ki-ki na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: further, 10 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, votive offerings for Aššur, also belonging to a merchant and sealed by him, Zikiki is bringing to you destined for Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar.

transliteration: a-na zi-ki-ki qí-bi-ma
translation: To Zikiki:

transliteration: a-ni-am a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR pì-qí-id-ma iš-tí a-wi-tí-šu e-ta-wu ú a-ta i-na re-ší-šu i-zi-iz-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lu ṭá-ba-tí
translation: Entrust this to Pilah-Ištar and join it to his consignment and then you personally may serve him and be positive over every shekel of silver.

transliteration: a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
translation: To Pilah-Ištar:

transliteration: a-ḫu-ni a-ta li-bi4 zi-ki-ki lá tù-lá-ma-an
translation: Our dear brother, do not make Zikiki angry.

transliteration: ṭup-pè-en₆ ší-na ša a-ṣé-er ì-lí-iš-tí-kál ù pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR lá-pu-tù ša šé-ep zi-ki-ki iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR-ni x x-ba-šu-ni iš-tí pá-né-e-ma šé-bi4-lá-ni-šu-nu
translation: There are two tablets that were written to Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar and that have been transported by Zikiki - send them together with our silver ... as soon as possible.

transliteration: i-na ṭup-pè-en₆ a-me-e-en₆ qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um wa-du
translation: Laying claim was indicated on those two tablets.

transliteration: tí-ir-tí a-lim(ki) da-nu-tù-um i-li-kam
translation: A strongly worded message from the City arrived.

transliteration: qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um lá-šu
translation: There is no way to lay claim.

transliteration: we-da-ku
translation: I am alone.

transliteration: ṭup-p
translation: Send those two tablets.

transliteration: a-ba-ba ra-bi4-ṣú-um ša šál-ma-a-šur a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur, seized us against Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur and Ṣilliya, his brother Ali-ahum's representative,

transliteration: um-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi4-ṣú-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im 22 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ i-na li-bi4-ku-nu
translation: and the attorney Ababa said to Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative: '22 talents of good copper are in your possession.'

transliteration: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu ke-na i-na li-bi4-ni
translation: Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, his brother Ali-ahum's representative, answered: 'Yes, it is in our possession.'

transliteration: i-na kà-ni-iš a-na-ku ù a-ḫi-i ni-za-ku-ma a-li URUDU i-na li-bi4-ni i-bu-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ni-ta-dí-a-ku-um
translation: In Kanesh I and my brother will make a settlement and wherever copper is shown as being owed by us, we shall deposit it for you.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur4-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dín
translation: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: IGI DU10-ṣí-lá-a-šur IGI šu-ki-tim IGI en-nu-um-sú-in
translation: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Šukkutum, by Ennam-Suen.

transliteration: um-ma i-dí-a-šur-ma a-na ḫa-nu-nu x a-lá-ḫi-im ù e-na-na-tim qí-bi-ma
translation: From Iddin-Aššur to hanunu, Ali-ahum and Ennanātum:

transliteration: ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pì-im ma-ḫi-ir a-lim(ki) en-um-(d)IM a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im ḫa-bu-ul
translation: Ennam-Adad owes worth 2 minas of refined silver at the market price in the City to a merchant.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am a-na-ku ú-kà-al
translation: I personally have his certified tablet.

transliteration: i-nu-mì DAM.GÀR-ru-um ṭup-pu-šu xxxx 15 GÍN.TA xxx na a-lim(ki) xxxx um … ... xxx KÙ.BABBAR … xxx az … ṣí-ib-tim li-iṣ-ḫi-ir
translation: When the merchant ... his tablet ... 15 shekels ... the City ... let him deduct ... of the interest.

transliteration: ṣí-ib-tám lá ta-ga-mì-lá-šu
translation: Make him no favours on the interest.

transliteration: ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-ma iš-tù a-li-ki-im pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: Make him pay and send it with the very first transport.

transliteration: iḫ-da-ma ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
translation: Take care to have him pay.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li-šu ša li-mì ša 30 ma-na iš-tí e-na-na-tim i-ba-ší
translation: The tablet concerning his debt to the eponyms, concerning 30 minas, is in Ennanātum's possession.

transliteration: … a li-bi4 ṭup-pè-a šu-uk-na-ma ù tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
translation: Place it among my tablets and then send me word.

transliteration: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma dan-a-šur a-lá-ḫu-um ù šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
translation: From Man-mahir, Dan-Aššur, Ali-ahum and Šu-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: mì-šu ša a-ma-kam a-šar lá a-bi-im ù um-mì-im na-lá-tí-ni-ma ù mu-ur-ṣa-am a-na mu-ur-ṣí-im tù-ra-du-ú
translation: Why are you lying around there where there is no father and no mother, making the disease worse?

transliteration: ki-ma a-na-kam a-na É DINGIR tù-ru-du-ma iš-tí DINGIR e-na-na-tim té-ta-ri-šu ù IGI i-li-kà tù-ta-na-nu-nu ù a-ḫu-um ù eb-ru-um li-ba-am i-da-na-ku-nu
translation: Instead of going down to the temple here, asking mercy from the god, praying constantly to your god so that brother and friend could give you encouragement,

transliteration: a-ta a-ma-kam ki-ma a-we-lim ra-qí-im ša-na-at ta-ta-šá-áb ša tí-ir-tám ù ḫu-šá-ḫa-am lá tí-šu-ú
translation: you have sat there for a year as an empty man, without purpose or wishes.

transliteration: a-na-kam um-me-a-nu a-bi-ku-nu ša ki-ma i-na pá-ni-tim té-ta-ta-ri-ša-ni a-na a-ḫi-kà ú-kà-lu-ma
translation: Your father's investors here offer those things to your brother which you earlier constantly asked me for,

transliteration: ù ki-ma a-ḫu-kà we-dí-ni-ma ù a šu-mì-kà ma-ga-ra-am ú-lá i-mu-a
translation: but, in fact, since your brother is alone he is of course unwilling to agree on your behalf.

transliteration: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí-ni ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: Urgent, set out and come here the very day you hear our letter!

transliteration: ù a-ḫi-ú-tum i-ta-bu-lu-kà
translation: Also, strangers may carry you away all the time.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN lu a-na ANŠE.ḪI.A lu a-na ḫi-šá-nim gu₅-mu-ur-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
translation: Agree to some 10 shekels of silver either for donkeys or for a pole and set out and come.

transliteration: KIŠIB šu-mì-a-bi-a DUMU zu-zu-ú KIŠIB lá-ba-na-da DUMU i-dí-sú-en₆ KIŠIB a-šùr-DU10 DUMU e-na-ma-nim
translation: Seal of Šumi-abiya, son of Zuzū, seal of Labān-nādā, son of Iddin-Suen, seal of Aššur-ṭāb, son of Ennamānum.

transliteration: 1 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša a-lim(ki) i-ṣé-er a-šur-DU10 a-ḫu-qar i-šu
translation: 1 talent of tin with seals of the city, Aššur-ṭāb owes to Ahu-waqar.

transliteration: i-tù-a-ar DINGIR-šu-GAL ṣú-ḫa-ri-im ša a-šur-DU10 iš-tù a-lim(ki) i-na ri-i-iš AN.NA 5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ma-sí-am ša-bu-ra-am a-na a-šur-DU10 a-ḫu-qar i-ša-qal
translation: When Ilšu-rabi, the servant of Aššur-ṭāb, returns from the city, immediately when he receives the tin, 5 talents of refined copper of good quality, in pieces, Ahu-waqar will pay to Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: 1 GÚ AN.NA-ak-šu a-ḫu-qar i-lá-qé
translation: and Ahu-waqar will get his 1 talent of tin.

transliteration: a-na la-ma-sà sí-tim … KIŠIB … mì-x x me-éḫ-ri xx ša ta-áš-pu-ri-ni ...
translation: To Lamassutum, seal of..., the duplicates which you sent.

transliteration: a-dí-da ú a-lá-ḫu-um a-šùr-iš-ta-ki-il₅ iš-ú-lu-ma
translation: Adida and Ali-ahum questioned Aššuriš-takil as follows:

transliteration: 3.33333 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-lim-a-šùr a-na na-ru-qí-kà a-dí-im-ma
translation: Šalim-Aššur invested 3.33333 minas of gold in your joint-stock capital,

transliteration: ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR na-ru-qá-kà ú-la-pí-tám
translation: and he wrote an amount of 10 minas of silver for your joint-stock capital.

transliteration: ša-lim-a-šùr i-na a-lim(ki) a-na li-mì-im ḫa-bu-ul-ma
translation: Šalim-Aššur is indebted to the eponym in the City,

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša ší-ip-kà-tim ša-lim-a-šùr ad-ma-ku-ni ṭup-pá-am šu-wa-tí qá-tí li-mì-im ú-kà-al-ma
translation: and the tablet of the investment Šalim-Aššur made to you, that very tablet is in the eponym's possession,

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ú né-ma-al-šu dí-in-ma a-ṣé-er li-mì-im li-li-ik-ma
translation: so pay the silver and the accrued profit, let it go to the eponym,

transliteration: ú ṭup-pá-am ša ší-ip-kà-tí-kà a-na ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí li-dí-nu
translation: and then he can give the tablet concerning your capital to your representatives.

transliteration: iš-tù x 3 ša-na-tim iš-tù bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim lu ta-li-kam
translation: Three years ago you came from Burušhaddum

transliteration: ú a-na iš-té-en ú ší-na tap-pá-e-a KÙ.BABBAR ú né-ma-al-šu ta-dí-in
translation: and you have given the silver and the accrued profit to one or two of my partners.

transliteration: a-na-ku ú ša qá-ta-at a-bi-a-a na-al-pu-tù ni-ta-na-lá-kà-ku-um KÙ.BABBAR ú né-ma-al-šu ta-dá-na-am ú-lá ta-mu-a
translation: But I and those who signed as my father's guarantors come to you time and again, but you refuse to give the silver and its accrued profit.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er ki-a-am-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ú 2 ma-na tù-uš-ta-ag-me-er-šu
translation: On top of this you have caused him to have expenses of one or two minas.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša li-mì-im a-na ṣí-ib-tim lá i-ma-id-ma
translation: The interest on the silver of the eponym must not increase

transliteration: É a-bi-a ú ší-ip-kà-tim ša a-bi ad-ma-ku-ni lá i-ta-ba-lá
translation: and my father's house and the investments my father made for you must not be lost.

transliteration: ší-ma-at KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma a-na É li-mì-im
translation: Give me the agreed amount in silver, let me send it to the eponym's office.

transliteration: a-na iš-ma-a-šùr DUMU ḫi-na-a a-ta-a-a DUMU bu-ṣí-a ú en-nam-a-šùr DUMU e-lá-ma DUB a-ku-ú-a DUMU a-šùr-i-dí
translation: To Išme-Aššur, son of hinnāya, Ataya, son of Buṣiya, and Ennam-Aššur, son of Elamma, tablet of Akūa, son of Aššur-idī.

transliteration: um-ma kà-ru-um a-na ú-bar-tim ša ku-bu-ur-na-at qí-bi-ma
translation: From the Kanesh colony to the trading station Kuburnat say:

transliteration: a-na-kam me-er-ú ša-lim-a-šùr im-ḫu-ru-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma
translation: Here the sons of Šalim-Aššur confronted us and said:

transliteration: a-šùr-iš-tí-kál DUMU a-šur-SIPA KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-bi-ni ḫa-bu-ul
translation: Aššuriš-tikal son of Aššur-rē'ī owes silver to our father,

transliteration: ú a-we-lam e-mu-qí-in e-ta-ú
translation: and he has spoken harshly to the man.

transliteration: ma-ṣa-ni a-na ša-sú-ḫi-šu
translation: We take responsibility for his forced transfer.

transliteration: a-ma-kam a-we-lam iš-tí šé-ep-IŠTAR ší-ip-ri-ni li-sú-ḫa-am
translation: Extradite the man there together with Šēp-Ištar, our messenger,

transliteration: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir šu-ku-tum ú i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: From Man-mahir, Šukkutum and Ikũn-pĩya to Ali-ahum:

transliteration: i-na 24 pí-ri-kà-ni ša ḫa-nu ub-lá-ni iš-té-en ḫa-nu a-na li-tab-ší-šu il₅-qé
translation: Of the 24 textiles that hanu brought, hanu has taken one for his clothes

transliteration: iš-té-en a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu šu-ut-ma il₅-qé
translation: and he has also taken one to pay for his food.

transliteration: ší-tí ṣú-ba-tí-kà 22 TÚG 4.83334 GÍN.TA ta-ad-nu
translation: The rest of your textiles, 22 pieces, were sold for 4.83334 shekels each.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu 1.66666 ma-na 6.66666 GÍN
translation: Their value in silver was 1.66666 mina 6.66666 shekels.

transliteration: ŠÀ.BA 5 GÍN KÙ e-ri-ib-tum ša AN.NA i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na PUZUR4-a-be-eḫ il₅-qé
translation: Thereof Puzur-Abeh has taken 5 shekels of silver, entrance tax for the tin, in Wahšušana;

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na am-tim ni-iš-qú-ul
translation: we paid 0.5 mina 4.5 shekels of silver to the maid.

transliteration: ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ir-dí-a-kum
translation: Ilī-ašrannī led it to you.

transliteration: 4 ma-na a qá-tí-šu ni-dín
translation: We gave 4 minas for his expenses.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ḫa-nu na-áš-a-kum
translation: hanu brings you the rest of your silver, 1 mina 6 shekels of silver under our seals.

transliteration: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šu-mì a-dí-da áš-qú-ul
translation: I paid 6 shekels of silver in the name of Adida.

transliteration: x GÍN ṭá-áb-tí áš-qú-ul
translation: I paid x shekels for my salt-fee.

transliteration: IGI PUZUR4-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
translation: Witnessed by Puzur-Aššur, son of Aššur-dan.

transliteration: šál-ma-a-šùr a-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-hi-ú-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR-ma mì-šu-um ší-im TÚG-ba-tí-a URUDU ta-aṣ-ba-at
translation: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištar, and Šalim-Aššur said to Amur-Ištar: "Why have you seized the copper that was the proceeds from my textiles?"

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ke-na 4 GÚ lá-mu-nam aṣ-ba-at
translation: Amur-Ištar answered: "Yes, I have seized 4 talents of poor copper."

transliteration: ba-lu-um hi-na-a ú ší-bé aṣ-ba-at
translation: I seized it without hinnaya's permission and without witnesses.

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma ha-bu-ra-ta-i-am tal-qé
translation: Šalim-Aššur said: "Did you take copper from Haburat?"

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ša i qá-tim x-ta-šu-šu al-qé
translation: Amur-Ištar answered: "I took what I could grab."

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-ta lu-qú-tí ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-aṣ-ba-at
translation: Amur Ištar continued: "But did you not seize my merchandise worth 10 minas of silver?"

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur mì-ma lá aṣ-ba-at-ma
translation: Šalim-Aššur answered: "I have seized nothing."

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a ṣú-ha-ri-a a za-al-pá áš-ta-pár
translation: Amur-Ištar said: "I have sent my servant to Zalpa."

transliteration: ṣú-ha-ri li-li-kam-ma lá-ta-wu
translation: When my servant comes I shall discuss further.

transliteration: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na-ku a-šé-e-kà ú-ul a-ta ta-šé-e-a-ni
translation: Amur-Ištar continued: "It is I who am suing you, not you who are suing me."

transliteration: IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI pu-šu-ki-in
translation: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni, by Pūšu-kēn.

transliteration: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
translation: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi-im DUMU a-šùr-i-dí KIŠIB i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-i-dí sū-in-na-da DUMU en-um-a-šùr tap-pá-i-ni
translation: Sealed by Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī, by Iddin-Ištar son of Aššur-idī; Suen-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur was our partner.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-he-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: The plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

transliteration: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
translation: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: 1 TÚG KI ša-ha-ma
translation: 1 textile owed by Šahama.

transliteration: 1 TÚG KI sú-is-ha-ra šu wa-áb-ri-ni
translation: 1 textile owed by Su-Ishara, our guest.

transliteration: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni
translation: Before Aššur-bāni.

transliteration: a-na ku-zi-zi-a IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí na-áb-sú-in a-na-na a-mur-IŠTAR ša-lim-ar-dí ma-nu-ki-DINGIR-a qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
translation: To Kuziziya, Ištar-lamassī, Nāb-Suen, Anna-anna, Amur-Ištar, Šalim-wardī and Mannum-kī-iliya from Ennam-Aššur:

transliteration: 1.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša ku-ku-wa ù ku-nu-ki-a ù 7 ANŠE.HI.A ṣa-lá-mì ú ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim i-a-um ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
translation: 1 ½ mina 5 shekels of silver sealed by Kukuwa and by me plus 7 black donkeys with their harness - all this belonging to me, Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ša ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša ku-ku-wa a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur DUMU MAN.IŠTAR ha-bu-lu-ni-ma 20 GÚ SÍG.HI.A a-na ša-pá-ar-tim ú-kà-lu-ni a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma
translation: In addition to this silver that Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you, for the 3 minas silver and its interest that Kukuwa owes to Mannum-kī-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar, and for which he holds 20 talents of wool as security - say to my representatives:

transliteration: a-ma-kam ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a i-ha-šu-hu-ni KÙ.BABBAR lu i-na ša ba-áb-tí-a ta-am-hu-ra-ni lu KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na ṣé-er a-na-na ku-nu-ki-a ú-šé-bi4-lá-ni a-na ṣí-ib-tim KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im dí-na-šu-nu-tí-ma
translation: Whatever silver Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya ask for there, lend them silver against interest according to the rate of the colony - from what silver you have received from my outstanding claims, or silver I sent to Anna-anna under my seal.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a me-er-i-ša ša qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu lu-up-ta-ma a-na am-tí-a ṭup-pá-am dí-na-ma a-dí a-lá-kà-ni
translation: Then write a tablet for Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya, her son, with joint liability, and give the tablet to my maid so it may remain in her possession until I come.

transliteration: a-na ṣé-er a-šùr-UTU i-na ba-áb ha-ra-ni-šu né-ru-ub-ma um-ma en-na-sú-in a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma
translation: We entered with Aššur-šamšī when he was about to go on a journey and Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī:

transliteration: a-pu-na lá-ma kà-sà-am ni-iš-tí-ú a-wa-tí-im lá-ta-wu-kum li-ba-tim lá ta-ma-lá
translation: Please, before we drink from the cup I want to declare something to you, do not get angry!

transliteration: i-nu-mì i-na wa-áš-ha-ni-a ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ni 2-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ha-ti tù-šé-bi-lá-kà
translation: When they detained me in Wašhaniya did my sister send you to me with 2 minas of silver?

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-UTU ke-na tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ma ú-lá a-dí-na-kum
translation: Aššur-šamšī answered: "Sure, she sent me, but I did not give it to you."

transliteration: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma u4-ma-am a-ha-tí ta-tù-ra-am
translation: Ennam-Suen then said: "Today my sister has come back here."

transliteration: um-ma ší-it-ma ta-al-tám-nam KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí ša iš-tù 8 ša-na-tim šé-ṣí-ma dí-nam
translation: And she said: 'You have done me wrong! Produce the silver and its interest due since eight years and give it to me!'

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma e-ni-ma-ma a-na šé-ep a-šur-i-mì-tí am-qú-ut
translation: Aššur-šamšī answered: "I threw myself down at the feet of Aššur-imittī."

transliteration: a-hu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-ma KÙ.GI 15 GÍN ù 1 ma-na sà-am-tum ma-lá ta-le-a-ni É.GAL-lam ṭá-i-ba
translation: Saying: 'Please, my brothers, here are gold, 15 shekels, and 1 mina of carnelian, appease the palace as well as you can'.

transliteration: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma a-na en-na-sú-in-ma šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-dí-im i-tù-ar al-kam-ma ší-bé-kà la-aṣ-ba-at-ma ma-lá e-pá-ší-im ep-ša-ni
translation: Aššur-šamšī also said to Ennam-Suen: "If the silver due has increased much then come here, let me seize your witnesses and do with me what you think best!"

transliteration: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma É.GAL-lúm KÙ.BABBAR ma-dam i-ṣé-ri-a i-šu
translation: Ennam-Suen answered Aššur-šamšī as follows: "The palace has a substantial silver claim on me."

transliteration: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-hi-im qí-bi4-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šùr-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

transliteration: 0.5 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù sà-hi-ir-tám ku-nu-ki-kà na-ki-ru-um ub-lam
translation: They brought me 29 shekels of silver and small goods under seal.

transliteration: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-na ú e-ni-iš-ta-ru-um ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
translation: Annima and Eništārum brought you 10 minas of silver.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni a-na ni-ip-lá-tí-a áš-ta-qal
translation: The silver you sent me I have paid to cover my balance payments.

transliteration: u4-mu-ú er-ša-sú-ma ILLAT kà-al-a-at
translation: The weather is bad and the caravan has been stopped.

transliteration: a-hu-a a-tù-nu i-na lu-qú-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im ṣú-ba-tù an-hu-tù-um i-ba-ší-ú
translation: My dear brothers, among the goods of the merchant there are some old textiles.

transliteration: ih-da-ma mì-li-ik lu-qú-tí-im mì-il₅-kà
translation: Take care and decide about the goods.

transliteration: a-hu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA x šé-bi-lá-ni-ma
translation: My dear brothers, send me silver, the proceeds from the tin.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-pì x i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
translation: And deposit my silver to my debit.

transliteration: a-dí tí-ir-ta-ak-nu i-lá-kà-ni ri-iš lu-qú-tim ú-kà-al
translation: I hold on to the goods until your orders arrive.

transliteration: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi4-ma um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik-ma
translation: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-mālik:

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi4-lá-ni ù ṭup-pè-kà a-na ma-lá té-er-tí-kà a-na a-lim(ki) uš-té-bi4-il₅
translation: The silver you sent me and your tablets I have now sent to the City following your instruction.

transliteration: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša É kà-ri-im ša a-na lá-qé-pí-im tù-šé-bi4-lu KÙ.BABBAR a-na lá-li-im a-dí-in
translation: As for the silver of the colonial office that you sent for Lā-qēpum, I gave that silver to Lalum.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR ù 5 TÚG ša a-di-ú-ma i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp lá-qé-pí-im-ma i-ší-qí-il₅
translation: In addition to that silver and the 5 textiles that I deposited, silver has been paid from Lā-qēpum's silver.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-kà a-na lá-qé-pí-im li-li-ik-ma i-na ga-ma-ar KÙ.BABBAR šu-um-kà i-na É kà-ri-im lu ni-il₅-pu-ut
translation: Let your silver go to Lā-qēpum and then, when the silver is spent we will register it in your name in the colonial office.

transliteration: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša a-mur-IŠTAR ša a-na lá-qé-pí-im ù ku-a-tí ha-bu-lu té-er-tí lá-qé-pí-im a-ṣé-er lá-li-im ù ku-a-tí i-li-kam-ma
translation: As for the silver of Amur-Ištar, which he owes to Lā-qēpum and to you, there came a message of Lā-qēpum, addressed to Lalum and you.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma u4-me ṣa-áb-ta-ma ma-lá e-tí-qú-ni 1 GÍN.TA a ma-na-im ší-sí-a-ma
translation: In which he said: "Seize (him for) the days he is overdue and claim (an interest of) 1 shekel per mina."

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
translation: And make him pay the silver and the interest on it.

transliteration: a-wa-tám a-šu-mì ni-a-tí mì-li-ik
translation: You must decide on behalf of us.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà mì-li-ik TÚG.HI.A ma-lá be-lúm-ba-ni e-zi-ba-ku-ni
translation: Sell all the textiles that Bēlum-bāni left behind for you.

transliteration: ba-tí-iq ù wa-tù-ur i-na ni-a-ú-tim-ma ma-na-im URUDU x-x-us-ma dí-in
translation: At any price, sell for copper by our own 1-mina-weight.

transliteration: lá i-na-dí-ú KÙ.BABBAR
translation: The silver must not be stocked.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-a ha-ru-mu-tum me-eh-ru-a ú ta-ah-sí-sà-tum
translation: My certified tablets, my copies and memoranda.

transliteration: ir-ma-a-šur a-na DU10-ṣí-li-a-šur DUMU ì-lí-a-lim lá-qé-pí-im DUMU PUZUR4-a-na ù i-šu-hi-im DUMU šu-lí ša ki-ma šu-lí iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Ir'am-Aššur seized us against Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, son of Ilī-ālum, La-qēpum, son of Puzur-Anna, and Išuhum, son of Šuli, representing Šuli.

translation: Thus says Tūram-ilī to Ennam-Aššur and Šu-Kūbum:

translation: Total: 1 talent 2 minas of tin.

translation: 1 shekel: for the sā'utu-tax.

translation: Šalim-Aššur took nothing on my account.

transliteration: É a-bi-ni a-na-ku ù a-tù-nu na-am-ra-ni

transliteration: a-pu-tum tí-ib-a-ni-ma a-tal-kà-nim
translation: Urgent: set out and come!

transliteration: 1 GÍN K1.BABBAR ší-tám ša DINGIR-ba-ni en-na-sú-in ub-lam
translation: Enna-Suen brought 1 shekel of silver, the remainder belonging to Ilī-bāni.

translation: Also, if you are in arrears with your working capitals, I shall pay (them).

transliteration: iš-tí a-ba-ba ta-ma-ku
translation: I have sworn together with Ababa.

transliteration: i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na a-lim(ki) i-lá-ak-ma
translation: As Issu-arik will go to the City,

transliteration: É-tí-šu ša bu-ri-im a-šar a-ni-i ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu-ni a-na tù-ud-ḫa-li-a a-ḫu tù-li a-na ší-mì-im i-dí-šu-nu
translation: he sold his houses by the well, where at present Šalim-Aššur is living, to Tudhaliya the brother of Tuli.

translation: We gave a tablet with our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

transliteration: IGI sú-kà-li-a DUMU a-mur-a-šùr

translation: 3 shekels of silver is owed by Kukkulānum.

translation: Witnessed by Iddin-Aššur son of Kuzilānum.

translation: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ahe, son of Irbi-Adad, and ...-muttabbil.

translation: Witnessed by Puzur-šadu’e brother of Ali-ahum.

translation: Each colony must escort him to the next, all the way until Kanesh.

translation: He must not suffer a delay of even one single day!

transliteration: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà šu-hu-bu-ur ù a-na-ku ni-zi-iz-ma a-lu-lá-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma
translation: In accordance with your instructions, Šu-hubur and I stood up and we seized Alulaya and said:

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu šu-qú-ul
translation: "Pay the silver and its interest!"

translation: Alulaya answered: "I sent the silver to him a month ago with Būr-Suen."

translation: With respect to the memorandum that you instructed me about, I questioned Alulaya, and he answered:

translation: I also questioned Ahu-waqar son of Zurzur, and he answered:

transliteration: ta-ah-sí-is-tám ili₅-ba-ni DUMU ba-ší-li ú-kà-al-ší
translation: "Ilī-bāni son of Baši-ilī has the memorandum."

transliteration: a-zu aṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: I seized Azu and he answered:

transliteration: ki ma-ṣí lu KÙ.BABBAR lu pì-ri-kà-ni-kà 5 GÍN.TA a-lá-qé
translation: "I shall take enough, either in silver or from your pirikannu-textiles at 5 shekels per piece."

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma ba-áb ha-ra-ni-kà KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú a-kà-na-kà-ma
translation: He said further: "At the start of your journey I shall seal the silver and its interest for you."

transliteration: a-dí ší-li-ip-kà-im šu-kà-tám aṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ší-li-ip-kà-um i-ba-ší
translation: Regarding the šilipka’um-textile I seized Šukkutum, and he answered: "The šilipka’um is available."

translation: It still is, and you cautioned me there, my lord, saying: "I have released them to you for its term."

translation: Today you keep hearing that trade is at a standstill.

transliteration: ší-mì a-da-ma a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
translation: I shall sell my goods, set out and come.

transliteration: ki-ma me-er-e šál-ma-a-šur a-na qá-ta-tim a-da-ku-nu
translation: Representing the sons of Šalim-Aššur I hand you over to guarantors.

transliteration: tup-pá-am ša ša-lá-ša-at a-tù-nu ha-bu-lá-tù-nu-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-ku-nu ra-ak-sú nu-kà-al
translation: We have in our possession a tablet stating that you three owe silver and that you are jointly liable.

translation: If you have oral witnesses against Šalim-Aššur,

transliteration: lu a-na a-ba-e-ni tí-šu-ú
translation: or if you have some against our fathers,

translation: or if you hold a tablet of satisfaction with the seal of our fathers,

translation: or if you have witnesses,

transliteration: a-na a-né-en-ma ru-a-ma mì-nam ni-qá-bi4
translation: then produce the evidence to these men, and what can we then say?

transliteration: me-er-ú me-tim né-nu lá tù-ba-ar-ni-a-tí
translation: We are inheritors. Do not drag us to court.

transliteration: i-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša hu-bu-ul PUZUR4-(d)EN.LÍL ša tup-pí-šu ha-ar-mì-im ù 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-ha-ma a-dí-šu-ni ŠÀ.BA 4.5 GÚ 4.5 ma-na URUDU al-qé
translation: Of the 4 minas of silver that are the debt of Puzur-Enlil, recorded in his certified tablet, and of the 0.5 mina of silver I had given him separately, thereof I obtained 4.5 talents 4.5 minas of copper.

translation: Of the 1 talent 50 minas of copper and 10 shekels of silver that are the debt of Puzur-Enlil, thereof I seized 1 mina of silver from Šalim-Aššur, son of Uphāqum.

transliteration: i-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša na-pá-hu iš-qú-lu-ni-ni 0.83333 ma-na 3.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ma-sú-ha-am qá-dum 3.33333 GÍN mu-ṭá-e i-na li-bi-šu-nu a-hu-ur
translation: Of the 4 minas of silver that the smiths paid to me, 0.83333 mina 3.3333 shekels of silver of inferior quality together with 3.3333 shekels underweight remain as owed by them.

translation: Thereof I paid 0.5 mina of silver to Puzur-Aššur of Šu-Iliya.

translation: 2 minas of silver from the proceeds on your tin which I received in Timelkiya.

transliteration: 10.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a be-a-lim ta-dí-nu-šu-ni a-na šé-ep-IŠTAR a-dí-in
translation: I gave 10.33333 shekels of silver, which you gave him for use, to Šēp-Ištar.

transliteration: 5.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-áp-tí-nim a-na am-tí-kà a-dí-in
translation: I gave 5.5 shekels of silver for a saptinnu-textile to your maid-servant.

translation: ... fine textile in ... Hurama I gave to you.

transliteration: 5.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šu-mì šé-ep-IŠTAR a qá-tí-kà tù-ṭá-hi-ú
translation: 5.25 shekels of silver which you added to your share on account of Šēp-Ištar.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na a-bu-a áš-qú-lu-ni
translation: 2 shekels of silver which I paid to my father.

transliteration: 0.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ir-i-bi4-im áš-qúl
translation: I paid 0.66666 mina 5 shekels of silver to Ir-ibum.

translation: I have a claim of 5 minas of tin and 3 kutānu-textiles against you.

translation: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative, seized us against Iddin-Aššur and the attorney Ababa said to Iddin-Aššur:

transliteration: tup-pá-am ša a-lim(ki) ta-áš-me
translation: You have heard the tablet from the City.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-ap ša-lim-a-šur ú-pá-ha-ar

transliteration: ù na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur iš-tù ITU.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mì-im a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-hi-im ub-lá-kum ša 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ip-qí-du-ni-ku-ni tù-šé-ra-am

transliteration: ù a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur la ta-tù-ar
translation: and you must not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

transliteration: 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur ta-pu-lu-ni a-na ma-lá na-áš-pè-er-tí-šu-nu iš-tù ITU.1.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mu-um a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-hi-im URUDU al-qé
translation: I have received the 40 talents of good copper about which you reached an agreement with Šalim-Aššur's investors, in accordance with their missive dated month Hubur, eponymy Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

transliteration: a-ma a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum lu i-de₈-ú
translation: Indeed, may these men know!

transliteration: na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni IGI a-ni-ú-tim ší-me-ma a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur lá ta-tù-ar
translation: Listen to the missive from the investors before these witnesses, and do not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

transliteration: KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi4-im DUMU i-tur4-DINGIR KIŠIB ú-nu-ba KIŠIB a-ší-a-at

transliteration: i-na áb-na-tí-ni i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They must pay using our weight stones.

transliteration: ITU.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mu-um i-dí-a-bum
translation: Month hubur eponymy Iddin-abum.

translation: Here we questioned Ibni-ilī, son of Aššur-šamšī, about his record and we also questioned his friends, Kūn-ilum and Iddin-Ištar, and the result was: The man is reliable and has a (good) record.

translation: With respect to your tin that you gave me, I will do you a favor: I will supply you in the city silver at a rate of (1 shekel) per 8 shekels (of tin).

translation: Elamma answered him: I will give it to you.

translation: When Elamma was about to set out on a journey Pilah-Aššur said: I gave you 15 minas of refined silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid for.

translation: Elamma answered: I will send them to you. Before Aššur's dagger I gave my testimony.

translation: Eponymy of the successor of Baziya, son of Šēp-ālum, month III.

translation: Witnesses: Ir'am-Aššur, Nar'am-Ea, Ennam-Adad, Rimānum

translation: The daughter of Aššur-dān, son of Zizum, has obtained an attorney from the City, who has left (and) is staying over there.

translation: If he makes an attempt at a slave-girl or the house, the house and the slave-girls belong to the lady!

translation: Say to the personnel of the lady that he must negotiate with them.

translation: Say to Elamma, thus Puzur-Anna: I have no father and lord but you!

translation: Don't be angry because I did not turn up with you.

translation: turn up with you. But with your next lot of merchandise I will gap

translation: Thus Ner'amtum, say to Elamma:

translation: They are bringing you a thin textile and a normal one, together with your merchandise, and a shawl for Lamassutum.

translation: As for the matter about which you wrote me, the gentleman has perished/disappeared.

translation: We were not to bring in the house somebody to replace my son, (but) because I became afraid, I was the one who has now brought one in.

translation: Do not get angry!

translation: Say to Elamma and Kurub-Ištar, say especially to Kurub-Ištar, thus Kūn-ilum:

translation: When Ēnah-ilī brought my merchandise here and one counted the textiles in the palace in your presence,

translation: you gave 16 textiles to/as gap and you brought (the rest ?) safely to gap

translation: gap he has/will indeed take(n) along from the silver that is due by gap

translation: Say to Elamma, thus Ištar-pilah:

translation: Hinnāya holds 3 minas of tin under seal and one must not open (the packet) lest he gets angry.

transliteration: KÙ.B. 1½ ma-na i-hi-id-ma šé-bi4-lam
translation: Take care to send me 1½ mina of silver.

translation: The silver is not his silver, it is the silver of Iddin-Suen!

translation: Thus Iddin-Aššur, say to Elamma and Ali-ahum, in particular to Ali-ahum:

translation: 1 mina of silver for which you drew up Saliya's debt-note, let Saliya give you that 1 mina of silver and

translation: as for the rest of the silver inspect my tablet to (discover) that I have already dunned Saliya four times, in order to be able to pay you.

translation: Please my brother, do me and my sons this favor.

translation: Say to Hinnāya and Elamma, thus Iddin-abum:

translation: Out of consideration for the merchandise, in order not let the goods be brought back, we, I and Dadiya, had ourselves booked as his guarantors for the 4 minas of silver.

translation: My representatives wrote me a letter

translation: After you had left your son sent 11 minas of silver and the 16 minas of silver, on which you had given

translation: Ennam-Aššur took these 16 minas of silver and sent 2 minas of gold and the 11 minas of silver to us.

translation: Later the son of Ṣallāmum produced 18 minas of silver.

transliteration: KÙ.B ù KÙ.GI pá-ni-am ú-ša-ší-ib TUR GAL nu-pá-he-er-ma
translation: This silver and the earlier amount of gold he gap We collected everything and

translation: Say to Elamma, thus speaks Aššur-ṭāb:

translation: A tablet recording a debt of Ennānum, with my seals, Didiya's son has with him for you.

transliteration: lu-qú-ut-kà ú-za-kà a-ta-lá-kam
translation: I will clear your merchandise (then) I will leave.

translation: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-rē'ī:

translation: A letter of the girl arrived here in which she wrote: Why did he not give you the tablet? You

translation: I wrote you three months ago asking, send me silver! Please, my father, send me one or two minas

translation: with the next caravan, lest your packet (of tin) is opened and you get angry.

transliteration: a-na E-lá-ma qi-bi-ma um-ma A-šùr-SIPA-ma
translation: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-rē'ī:

transliteration: 2 šu-lu-up-kà-ú ša ú-šé-bi-lá-ni A-šùr-mu-ta-pí-il5 a-na 30 ma-na ma-sí-am lá-ma: a-li-kà-ni il5-qé-šu-nu

translation: Afterwards he said: Take your textiles!

translation: As for 1 gap textile, instead of it they asked for another one.

translation: They deposited the textile(s) before me.

translation: Let a message of yours come here so that they give me the price of the textiles, then I will leave.

translation: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-nādā and Aššur-imittī:

translation: as import-tax gap we paid. Instead of x minas of tin we handed over to Aššur-mūtappil ½ mina of silver.

translation: Aššur-imittī took ⅓ mina of tin.

translation: The lady took 3 textiles.

translation: 27 shekels was the price of a donkey, 2 shekels, expenditures in silver, Ah-šalim took 2 textiles of the harnesser.

translation: We will settle accounts with Ah-šalim.

transliteration: a-na E-lá-ma qi-bi-ma um-ma A-hu-wa-qar
translation: Say to Elamma, thus Ahu-waqar:

transliteration: a-dí ṭup-pí-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma KIŠIB A-lá-hi-im a-na E-lá-ma lá-pí-it
translation: As for the tablet about which you wrote me as follows: Seal of Ali-ahum, to Elamma is written (on it),

transliteration: ṭup-pu-um: i-li-bi4 ṭup-pé-kà: i-ba-ší
translation: that tablet is to be found among your tablets,

transliteration: Ha-na-a ù Id-na-a ik-nu-ku-šu
translation: Hanāya and Idnāya have sealed it.

translation: If gap return

translation: Say to Elamma, thus Ahu-waqar:

translation: You wrote me as follows: (There is) a tablet wrapped in a rag, on the face of which is written: Seal of Ali-ahum to Hinnāya and Elamma.

transliteration: i-li-bi4 ṭup-pé ša A-šur-DÙG né-mu-ur-ma lá-šu
translation: We looked for it among the tablets of Aššur-ṭāb, but it is not there.

transliteration: a-na A-šur-DÙG ni-iš-tap-ra-am
translation: We have now sent a letter to Aššur-ṭāb.

transliteration: a-šu-mì am-tí-im ša A-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni Dan-A-šur ni-iš-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ší-im GEME₂ a-na-ku: i-ra-mì-ni-a áš-qúl
translation: As for the slave-girl of Aššur-taklāku, about whom you wrote us, we asked Dān-Aššur and he said: It was me who paid the price of the slave-girl out of my own means.

transliteration: LUGAL-IŠKUR a-na Wa-ah-šu-ša-na i-lá-ak ší-be ú-ša-a-lá-ma za-ku-sà: ni-ša-pá-ra-kum
translation: Šarrum-Adad will go to Wahšušana, he will interrogate the witnesses and then we will send you definite information.

translation: Thus Elamma and Kurub-Ištar, say to Dada and Ēnah-ilī:

translation: The 30 minas of silver that Ah-šalim brought to your father, if there is tin available at a rate of 15 shekels (to 1), then buy it and send it to me.

transliteration: šu-ma i-na 15 GÍN.TA ba-tí-iq mi-iš-lam AN.NA mi-iš-lam TÚG.HI.A ša-ma-ma i-pá-ni-im-ma: áb-kà-nim
translation: It the rate is less than 15 shekels (to 1) then buy for one half of it tin and for the other half textiles and ship them to me with the first opportunity.

transliteration: a-ní-ša-am a-ba-ra-im li-ik-šu-dam
translation: It should reach me here before the suspension of traffic.

transliteration: i-nu-mì AN.NA ù TÚG.HI.A ta-kà-na-ká-ni i-pá-ni šu-uq-lá-tim ù sí-ke TÚG.HI.A ša DAM.GÀR lá-pí-ta-nim
translation: When you seal the tin and the textiles write on the packets (with tin) and on the hem of the textiles Belonging to tamkārum.

transliteration: i-ki-dim a-wa-at-ku-nu lá i-ša-me
translation: No word of you should be heard outside!

transliteration: KÙ.B ša E-la-ma
translation: The silver belongs to Elamma.

transliteration: a-na En-um-A-šùr Da-di-a: Hi-na-a I-dí-a-bi4-im: A-ku-a ù A-ta-a qi-bi4-ma um-ma E-la-ma-ma
translation: To Ennam-Aššur, Dadiya, Hinnāya, Iddin-abum, Akūa and Ataya, say, thus Elamma:

transliteration: a-na lu-qú-tí-ku-nu AN.NA ú TÚG.HI.A ša Ì-lí-a-lúm ir-de5-a-ni: i-nu-mì ni-mí-ig-ru-ma AN.NA ú TÚG.HI.A al-qé-ú
translation: As for your merchandise, tin and textiles, which Ilī-ālum brought here, when we had reached an agreement and I had taken the tin and textiles,

transliteration: šu-ma kà-ru-um ša-du-a-tám il5-té-qé i-na KÙ.B.-áp I-lí-a i-na ša na-ru-qí-šu La-qé-ep: lá-qá-am
translation: I was authorized, if the colony levied the šaddu'utu-tax, to take it from Iliya's silver, that of his joint-stock fund (managed by?) La-qēp.

transliteration: qá-bi-a-ku: ṭup-pá-ak-nu ha-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
translation: I have in my possession a valid record of yours (to that effect).

transliteration: a-na-kam a-na kà-ri-im a-tù-ur um-ma a-na-ku-ma lu-qú-tum i-a-tum mi-šu-um ša-du-a-tám
translation: Here I turned to the colony and I declared: The merchandise belongs to me, why have you levied šaddu'utu-tax?

transliteration: tù-ša-dí-a um-ma šu-nu-ma lu-qú-tum a-na ša Ì-lí-a ša-ak-na-at-ma nu-ša-dí um-ma a-na-ku-ma lá-at-ma lu-qú-tum lu i-a-tù-ni
translation: They answered: The merchandise has been joined to that of Iliya and therefore we levied it. I said: I am ready to swear that the merchandise is truly mine!

transliteration: ú a-le-ma a-na kà-ri-im ša-du-a-tám il5-té-qé-ú ú-la ig-da-am-lu-ni
translation: But, wherever they collected the šaddu'utu-tax for the colony they have not obliged me.

transliteration: 36 ma-na AN.NA il5-qé-ú ŠÀ.BA 6 ma-na ki-iš-da-at Ku-ni-lim ú-ṣa-he-er
translation: They took 36 minas of tin from which I deducted 6 minas that were for Kūn-ilum's account.

transliteration: a-hu-ú-a a-tù-nu 30 ma-na AN.NA ma-lá dá*-tí-šu mu-ṭé-e-šu ú ni-is-ha-tí-šu
translation: Please, my brothers, send me with the first opportunity 30 minas of tin, as much as amounts to its road-tax, its underweight

transliteration: i-pá-ni-ma šé-bi4-lá-nim-ma a-na-kam i-KÙ.B-pi-ku-nu lá a-lá-qé
translation: and the import-tax on it, so that I do not have to take it from your silver here.

transliteration: mi-šu-um áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ku-nu-ti-ma šé-bu-lam lá ta-mu-a
translation: Why must I write you time and again, while you refuse to send it?

transliteration: um-ma E-lá-ma-ma a-na A-šùr-DÙG qi-bi-ma
translation: Thus Elamma, say to Aššur-ṭāb:

transliteration: KÙ.B. 1 ma-na ma-lá tù-tù-ú pá-ni-a-ma šé-bi-lam KÙ.B. ma-lá i-qá-tí-kà i-ba-ší-ú *x-kà-ma a-ta ki-lá
translation: Send me every mina of silver as soon as you find it. All the silver you have already available you must retain for yourself.

transliteration: 6½ TÚG.HI.A káb-tù-tim SIG5 ša Šu-bi-ri-im Ku-ni-lúm na-áš-a-kum
translation: 6½ heavy textiles, of good quality, of Šubarean make, Kūn-ilum is bringing you.

transliteration: mu-dí-a-am ZI-lá-tí-a-am ṣa-ba-at-ma ṭù-re-šu-nu lu-ša-dí-id-ma a-ni-ib-ra-re lu-sí-ma-ku-šu-nu-ma ma-lá KÙ.B. 1 GÍN tù-šé-lu-ú
translation: Get hold of a specialist from Zilat and let him stretch their yarns and make them suitable for you for nibrāru-garments, so that you can realize at least some silver.

transliteration: lu-bu-šé ra-qá-tim ù šu-lu-up-ki-e iš-tí wa-ar-ki-ú-tim ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: With the next shipment I will send you garments, thin textiles and Šulupkian textiles.

transliteration: lu šu-ul-hu lu ma-ku-hu ša a-ma-kam ṭá-áb-ú-ku-um a-mu-ur-ma té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma i-ha-ra-an
translation: Look out for šulhu- or makūhu-textiles over there that please you and let your report come to me. And let with every single

translation: caravan gap regularly come to me, so that at least some silver becomes available to me.

translation: Say to Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur, Dadiya and Ataya, thus Elamma: You said:

translation: 17 minas of copper from the price for a house-plot of Nūr-ilī is still due from Aššur-rēṣī.

transliteration: 8 ma-na URUDU ša DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU Ib-ni-lí KI A-ta-a URUDU
translation: 8 minas of copper belonging to Ilī-bāni, son of Ibni-ilī, is due from Ataya.

transliteration: ma-lá i-na li-bi4-šu-nu i-ba-ší-ú ší-si-a-ma li-qí-a ú a-ṣé-er ša KÙ.GI ṭí-ih-a-ma
translation: Settle accounts for all the copper they still owe and collect it and add it to that derived from the gold.

transliteration: ú šu-ma i-na ba-áb-tí-a mi-ma tal-qé-a ku-ta-ni ša-ma-ma šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: Moreover, if you have collected anything of my outstanding claims, buy for it kutānu-textiles and send them to me.

transliteration: a-na A-ta-a qi-bi4-ma ṭup-pá-am na-áš-pár-tamₓ(TUM) ša A-šur-la-ma-sí ša a-šu-mì tá-ad-mi-iq-tim ša a-na
translation: Say to Ataya: The tablet with the letter of Aššur-lamassī concerning the free loan he entrusted

transliteration: a-bi4-kà ip-qí-du na-áš-ú-ni-kum a-ma-kam ṭup-pá-am ší-me-ma li-ba-kà lá i-lá-mi-in
translation: to your father, which they are bringing to you, read that tablet over there, but do not get angry. Please,

transliteration: a-hi a-ta i-na ša-ha-at ša-zu-úz-tí-a i-zi-iz-ma i-na a-lá-ak ma-áš-kà-tí-a TÚG.HI.A iš-té-na ú ša-na šé-bi4-lam-ma lá-ag-mi-il5-kà
translation: my brother, assist my representative(s) and send me, when a shipment of mine starts its journey, each time one or two textiles, then I will do you a favor (in return).

transliteration: ša 10 ma-na AN.NA ša I-ku-pí-Ištar a-na E-lá-ma i-dí-nu 1⅔ ma-na KÙ.B. Im-dí-DINGIR il5-qé:
translation: that for the 10 minas of tin that Ikūn-pī-Ištar had given to Elamma Imdī-ilum received 1⅔ mina of silver.

translation: If the textiles have been sold, let your report come.

translation: Salim-Assur, son of Iphurum, is the bearer of the silver.

translation: If your journey is imminent and you are coming, bring it to your representative Ashur-bel-shadue where he is going out, and let him sell it at any price, and let your later shipment come to me.

translation: To Ashur-malik: Usur-sha-Ashur and Ashur-malik; thus says Ashur-bel-shadu'e:

translation: Ashur-shamsi and Ashur-bel-shadue brought 6 talents 3 1/3 minas of tin and 84 textiles into Purushhattum.

transliteration: 48 1/2 ma-na KÙ.B A-šùr-be-el-SA.TU ú-šé-ri-a-am
translation: Ashur-bel-shadue brought back 48 1/2 minas of silver.

translation: We took 2 minas 2 shekels of silver from Kurub-Ishtar and we put it into the package.

transliteration: A-mur-Ištar na-áš-a-ku-um
translation: Amur-Ishtar is bringing it to you.

transliteration: 5/6 ma-na 1 GÍN ša-du-a-tám ni-dí-in
translation: We gave 5/6 mina 1 shekel as transport-tax.

transliteration: 11 na-ru-uq ŠE-am ŠÀ.BA na-ru-uq 2 DUG ar-ša-tám i-ṣé-er Lu-ur-me-a ù Wa-al-wa-lá Wa-lá-wa-lá tí-šu
translation: Walawala has a claim against Lurmea and Walwala for 11 sacks of barley, out of which one sack and 2 jars are wheat.

translation: From the hamuštum-period of Enna-Suen, he shall measure out the grain at harvest time.

transliteration: šu-ma lá im-du-ud ki-ma a-wa-at Kà-ni-eš ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
translation: If he does not measure it out, they shall add interest according to the regulations of Kanesh.

transliteration: a-na ú-ṭí-tim a-ni-tim a-ša-sú šu-a-tí ú Ta-ri-mì-iš-na a-al-šu a-da-gal
translation: For this grain, I shall look to that wife of his and his city Tarimišna.

transliteration: a-na A-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma A-šur-ma-lik
translation: To Alahum speak, thus says Ashur-malik:

translation: Behold, listen to the testimony that Takhashali took regarding Alahum son of Nur-Sin.

translation: Takhashali seized us against Alahum son of Nur-Sin and thus Takhashali said to Alahum:
