translation: As for the 11 talents of good copper and 14 talents of shikum-copper of my lord Alahum, which I entrusted to you for Purushhattum to Ashur-tab and which you brought: to whom did you give the copper?

transliteration: um-ma A-lá-hu-um-ma : A-šùr-DÙG a-na Pu-ru-uš-ha-tim lá ak-šu-ud
translation: Thus Alahum said: I did not reach Ashur-tab in Purushhattum.

transliteration: té-er-tù-šu : a-ṣé-er En-um-A-šur DUMU A-ni-nim Ku-zi-a DUMU Bu-zi-zi ú Li-ip-tí-Ištar DUMU Da-gán-ma-al-ki-im i-li-kam
translation: His instructions came to Ennum-Ashur son of Anninum, Kuzia son of Buzizi, and Lipti-Ishtar son of Dagan-malkum.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-ma URUDU lu SIG5 lu ší-kam ša A-lá-hi-im ša Ta-ha-ša-li ú-šé-bi-lá-ni a-na KÙ.B dí-na-ma i-na KÙ.B pá-qá-dim šu-mì A-lá-hi-im wa-dí-a eq-lam a-šu-mì A-lá-hi-im le-tí-qám
translation: Thus he said: Sell for silver the copper, whether good or shikum, which Takhashali sent to me for Alahum, and when handing over the silver, make known Alahum's name; let it travel overland in Alahum's name.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um Ùh-šu-ša-na ṣa-he-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša A-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
translation: Regarding these matters, the colony of Uhshushana, small and great, gave us to the court and we gave our testimony before the dagger of Ashur.

transliteration: a-na A-šùr-ma-lik I-tur4-DINGIR ù A-šùr-ma-lik qí-bi-ma um-ma A-šùr-bé-el-SA.TU-ma
translation: To Ashur-malik, Itur-ilum, and Ashur-malik speak: thus says Ashur-bel-shadu'e.

transliteration: a-wa-tim : ša I-dí-Ištar ú-ga!(ša)-me-er-ma
translation: He has settled the matters of Iddin-Ishtar.

transliteration: 17 ma-na KÙ.B a-na 5 ha-am-ša-tim : i-ša-qal
translation: He will pay 17 minas of silver in 5 hamushtum-periods.

transliteration: i-na 13 ma-na KÙ.B qá-tí ša-ak-na-at
translation: My hand is placed on 13 minas of silver.

transliteration: A-lá-hu-um DUMU Nu-ur-ZU KÙ.B ki-ma i-a-tí ú-kà-al
translation: Alahum, son of Nur-Suen, holds the silver in my stead.

transliteration: a-na Dur4-hu-mì-it a-ṭá-ra-sú
translation: I am sending him to Durhumit.

transliteration: i-na Dur4-hu-mì-it URUDU i-ša-qal
translation: In Durhumit, he will weigh out copper.

transliteration: a-na-kam A-lá-ha-am ú-ša-hi-iz
translation: Here I have instructed Alahum.

transliteration: a-na A-la1-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma A-šùr-ma-lik I-tur4-DINGIR ù A-šùr-DÙG-ma
translation: Speak to Alahum, thus says Ashur-malik, Itur-ili, and Ashur-tab.

transliteration: a-dí ṭup-pí-kà ša Tí-me-el-ki-a-i-im ma-ṣa-ar-ta-kà ni-ip-té-ma
translation: Regarding your tablet of the Timelkiyan, we opened your safe-box.

transliteration: ṭup-pu ša Tí-me-el-ki-a-i-im ni-iš-e-ma la1-šu-ú
translation: We searched for the tablet of the Timelkiyan, but it is not there.

transliteration: É Bu-zu-ta-a ù Šu-Ku-bi-im ni-iš-e-ma ù áš-ra-kam la1-šu-ú
translation: We searched the house of Buzutaya and Shu-Kubum, and there also it is not there.

transliteration: a-ta a-ma-kam hu-ta-sí-is-ma ṭup-pí-kà a-šar té-zi-bu té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam
translation: Think about it there, where you left your tablet, and let your report come to me.

transliteration: A-šùr-DÙG a-na Tí-me-el-ki-a i-la1-ak-ma a-ma-la1 me-eh-ri-im ša Tí-me-el-ki-a-i-im ša ta-dí-nu-šu-ni KÙ.B ša lá-qá-im i-la1-qé
translation: Ashur-tab is going to Timelkiya and according to the copy of the Timelkiyan that you gave him, he will take the silver that is to be taken.

transliteration: am-ma ší-tám u4-me i-ša-kà-šu-nu-tí-ma ṭup-pì-šu-nu ú-da-áš
translation: Look, he will set the remaining days for them and he will renew their tablet.

transliteration: a-na wa-ar-ki-tim pá-la1-ah
translation: Be concerned for the future.

transliteration: a-ma-kam ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-kà a-na ša ki-ma A-šùr-DÙG dí-ma
translation: Give your sealed tablet there to the representative of Ashur-tab.

transliteration: a-na i-dí-i ṭup-pu-kà la1-šu-ú-ni ú KÙ.B-pì-kà la1 ru-a-qí-im a-na ší-a-tí ni-iš-pu-ra-ku-um
translation: Because your tablet is missing and so that your silver is not delayed, for that reason we have written to you.

transliteration: i-hi-id-ma té-er-ta-kà iš-tí pá-ni-im-ma li-li-kam
translation: Take care and let your report come to me with the very first messenger.

transliteration: a-na A-šur-ma-lik I-tur4-DINGIR ù A-šur-ma-lik qí-bi4-ma um-ma A-šur-be-el-ša-du-e-ma
translation: Speak to Ashur-malik, Itur-ili, and Ashur-malik: thus says Ashur-bel-shadu'e.

transliteration: KÙ.B i-li-bi4 Šu-zu-zu aṣ-ba-at
translation: I seized the silver from Shuzuzu.

transliteration: a-Kà-ni-iš a-na ša ki-ma a-bi4-kà šu-pu-ur-ma KÙ.B lu-ša-áš-qí-lu-ni
translation: Write to Kanish to your father's representatives so that they make him pay the silver.

transliteration: KÙ.B a-mì-ša-am i-ta-áb-lam
translation: The silver has been brought there.

transliteration: i-zi-za-ma KÙ.B ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
translation: Stay and make him pay the silver.

transliteration: um-ma A-šùr-i-dí-ma a-na A-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus says Ashur-idi: speak to Alahum.

transliteration: ší-bu-tum dì-nam : i-dí-nu-ma a-na 7 li-mì ù : 1 me-at sà-am-ru-a-tim ta-da-nim i-dí-nu-ku-nu
translation: The elders gave a judgment and they charged you with giving 7,100 nails.

transliteration: mì-iš-li-kà 6 ma-na KÙ.B a-na ṣí-ib-tim al-qé-ma áš-qúl
translation: I took your half, 6 minas of silver, at interest and I paid it.

transliteration: iš-tù ITU.KAM kán-mar-ta 1 ma-na-um 10 GÍN.TA i-lá-kà-ku-um
translation: From the month Kanmarta, (interest) of 10 shekels per 1 mina will accrue for you.

transliteration: i-hi-id-ma KÙ.B ù ṣí-ba-sú : šé-bi4-lam
translation: Pay attention and send me the silver and its interest.

transliteration: mì-ša-al : AN.NA ša a-na sà-am-ru-a-tim ta-dí-a-ni : le-qé
translation: Take the half of the tin which you set aside for the nails.

transliteration: a-na 1 ma-na KÙ.B 2 ku-sí-té-en 6 me-at sà-am-ru-a-tim ru-gu5-ma-ú na-ad-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
translation: Claims for 1 mina of silver, 2 kusitu-garments, and 600 nails have been laid against you.

transliteration: a-da-an-ma a-ša-pá-ra-kum
translation: I will give (them) and then I will write to you.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.B a-na DINGIR-šu-ra-bí ša ṭup-pá-am : na-áš-a-ku-ni dì-in
translation: Give 2 shekels of silver to Ilushu-rabi, who is bringing the tablet to you.

transliteration: a-na A-la1-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma Ì-lí-dan A-šùr-i-mì-tí ù A-ú-ke-en6-ma
translation: Speak to Alahum, thus says Ili-dan, Assur-imitti, and A-uken.

transliteration: um-me-a-nu-kà : mì-ma ša ma-at e-li-tim a-na ba-áb DINGIR : ú-šé-ri-du ù ni-a-tí : GÍR ša A-šùr ú-ša-aṣ-bi-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Regarding your creditors: they made us take the dagger of Assur concerning whatever they brought down from the upper country to the Gate of the God.

transliteration: KÙ.B 1 GÍN ša ta-dí-na-ni az-ku-ur
translation: I declared the one shekel of silver which you gave me.

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma : sà-al-ú
translation: They said: "Lies!"

transliteration: a-na A-limki : i-li-ku-ma
translation: They went to the City.

transliteration: 12 ma-na KÙ.B ša Šu-Nu-nu ta-bé-el
translation: You possess 12 minas of silver belonging to Shu-Nunu.

transliteration: 10 ma-na ša ta-dí-na-ni ta-bé-el ù 7 GÚ LÁ 20 ma-na URUDU ta-ša-qal
translation: You possess 10 minas which you gave me, and you shall pay 7 talents less 20 minas of copper.

transliteration: nu-sà-li-šu-nu-tí-ma um-ma né-nu-ma a-na ší-li-tí-šu 5 ma-na a-na ni-qí-ku-nu : le-qé-a
translation: We beseeched them, saying: "Take 5 minas for your sacrifices for his debt."

transliteration: ú-la1 kà-la1-šu-ma a-šé-lu-tim : ak-la1-šu
translation: Or I held back all of it for the third parties.

transliteration: a-wi-lu : ú-la1 im-gu5-ru-ni-a-tí-ma a-na A-limki : i-tal-ku
translation: The men did not agree with us and they have gone to the City.

transliteration: šu-ma : a-ší-a-ma-tim : ta-ša-kà-nam : i-ṣa-bu-tù
translation: If you deposit it for me for purchases, they will seize it.

transliteration: um-ma Ta-ha-ša-i-li-ma a-na A-šur-be-el-SA.TU ù A-šur-ma-lik qí-bi4-ma
translation: Thus says Tahaša-ili: to Aššur-bel-šadu and Aššur-malik say:

transliteration: 1 1/3 ma-na KÙ.B ni-is-ha-sú DIRI : ku-nu-ki-a : ša i-li-bi4-a a-bu-ku-nu : i-dí-ú
translation: 1 1/3 minas of silver, its nishatu-tax added, under my seals, which your fathers deposited with me.

transliteration: 1/3 ma-na KÙ.B ku-nu-ki-a a-Na-na-a 12 GÍN KÙ.B ku-nu-ki-a : a-na Ší-ma-at-Ištar Ha-da-a-ni ù Ša-lim-be-lí na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
translation: Hadāni and Šalim-belī are bringing to you 1/3 mina of silver under my seals for Nanaia and 12 shekels of silver under my seals for Šimat-Ištar.

transliteration: ma-ma-an DUMU um-me-a-nim : ša a-na A-limki : i-lu-ku pì-iq-da-ma : a-ṣé-er a-bi4-ku-nu : lu-bi4-il5
translation: Entrust it to any agent who is going to the City so that he may bring it to your father.

transliteration: 1/3 ma-na 4 1/3 GÍN KÙ.B a-na A-da-da-a : a-dí-in
translation: I gave 1/3 mina and 4 1/3 shekels of silver to Adadā.

transliteration: ù 35 ma-na URUDU ší-im 1 ANŠE i-li-bi4-šu
translation: And 35 minas of copper, the price of one donkey, are owed by him.

transliteration: ù a-na Ša-lá-tù-wa-ar i-ta-lá-ak
translation: And he has gone to Šalatuwar.

transliteration: I-tur4-DINGIR a-na A-šur-be-el-SA./TU iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma A-lá-hu-um DUMU Nu-ur-ZU A-šur-ma-lik a-hu-šu i-za-zu
translation: Itur-il seized us against Ashur-bel-shadu'e, and Alahum, son of Nur-Suen, and Ashur-malik, his brother, were present.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-be-el-ša-du-e-/ma KÙ.B ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu ša-bu-a-ku
translation: Thus said Ashur-bel-shadu'e: 'I am satisfied with the silver and its purchases.'

transliteration: ṭup-pu-um ša 4 ma-na 12 GÍN ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu ša ku-nu-uk A-lá-hi-im ú A-šur-ma-lik ma-ah-ri-ni i-du-ku
translation: The tablet of 4 minas 12 shekels and its purchases with the seal of Alahum and Ashur-malik was invalidated in our presence.

transliteration: 8 ma-na AN.NA a-na Na-qí-du-ú a-dí-in
translation: I gave 8 minas of tin to Naqidu.

transliteration: a-na Šu-Ku-bi4-im ù Bu-zu-ta-a qí-bi-ma um-ma A-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: Speak to Shu-Kubum and Buzutaya, thus says Alahum.

transliteration: a-na-kam a-wa-tí-a iš-tí um-me-a-ni-a ag-ta-mar
translation: I have finished my business here with my creditors.

transliteration: ma-lá e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni iš-tí DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim ša KÙ.B 1 GÚ iš-tí-šu i-lu-ku 30 ma-na.TA KÙ.B iš-ri-ša-ma a-na É be-tí-a šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: Whatever I left with you, send to my house 30 minas of silver each in ten shipments with a reliable agent with whom 1 talent of silver is traveling.

transliteration: ú šu-ma tá-da-ga-lá-ma i-na wa-ar-ki-tim KÙ.B 5 GÚ iš-tí DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim i-lá-ak 1 GÚ 20 ma-na KÙ.B 2 mu-ta-ta-an ša i-na É be-tí-a e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni qá-du-um li-wi-tí-ší-na šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: And if you see that later 5 talents of silver will travel with a reliable agent, send to me the 1 talent 20 minas of silver, the two half-packs which I left with you in my house, including their wrapping.

transliteration: šu-ma qá-du-um li-wi-tim lá i-ma-hu-ru pá-ṭí-ra-ma né-pì-ší ú e-pá-da-tim pì-iq-da
translation: If they do not accept them with the wrapping, unpack and entrust the packets and the ephods (to them).

transliteration: a-hu-a-tù-nu a-na-kam KÙ.B 1 GÚ i-lá i-dí-im il5-ta-qé-ú
translation: You are my brothers; here they have taken 1 talent of silver without cause.

transliteration: i-na ṭup-pì-a ha-ru-mu-tim a-na ma-ma-an ṣí-ib-tám lá ta-pá-ṭá-ra
translation: Do not release the interest to anyone according to my certified tablets.

transliteration: En-um-DINGIR ṭù-ur-da-nim
translation: Send Ennum-ilum here.

transliteration: um-ma A-lá-hu-um-ma a-na A-šur-ma-lik DUMU A-šur-ba-ni ú A-šur-ma-/lik DUMU Lá-qé-pì-im qí-bi4-ma
translation: Thus says Alahum: speak to Ashur-malik, son of Ashur-bani, and Ashur-malik, son of La-qepim.

transliteration: me-eh-ra-tum ša ṭup-pè-a ha-ru-mu-tim a-ma-kam A-šur-ma-lik li-il5-qé-ma ú DAM.QAR-re-a li-iṣ-ba-at-ma a-ṣé-ri-ku-nu lu-ṭá-hi-a-ma
translation: Ashur-malik should take the copies of my certified tablets there, and he should seize my creditors and bring them to you.

transliteration: ša ša-áš-qú-lim ša-áš-qí-lá
translation: Make them pay whatever is to be paid.

transliteration: ú a-šar ta-da-ga-lá-/ni ma-lá ta-le-e-/a-ni ep-ša
translation: And wherever you see fit, do as much as you can.

transliteration: ú ṭup-pè-a ha-ru-mu-tim pì-tí-a
translation: And open my certified tablets.

transliteration: šu-ma DAM.QAR-ru ša ša-qá-lim i-ba-ší a-hu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-té-er-tí-a ih-da
translation: If there are creditors to be paid, you are my brothers; pay attention to my instructions.

transliteration: ú a-na-ku a-wi-il5 gi5-mì-li
translation: And I am a man of favors.

transliteration: ki-ma Pí-lá-ah-Ištar im-x im-hu-ur
translation: He received (it) instead of Pilah-Ištar.

transliteration: 1 me-at 30 ša I-dí-Sú-in DUMU Sà-ba-sí-a Ša-lim-A-šùr il5-qé
translation: Šalim-Aššur took 130 (units) of Iddin-Suen, son of Sabasia.

transliteration: a-na I-tur4-DINGIR-lim En-na-Sú-in Na-ba-na-ta Ša-lim-a-hi-im qí-bi4-ma um-ma Šu-Be-lúm-ma
translation: Speak to Itūr-ilim, Enna-Suen, Nabanata, and Šalim-ahum; thus says Šu-Bēlum.

transliteration: šu-ma a-hu-a a-tù-nu
translation: If you are my brothers.

transliteration: šu-ma be-lu-a a-tù-nu
translation: If you are my lords.

transliteration: a-na-kam ki-a-am tám-kà-ri-šu i-ta-na-lu-ku
translation: His creditors are constantly going about here in this manner.

transliteration: áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ku-nu-tí-ma té-er-ta-ak-nu ma-tí-ma lá i-li-kam
translation: I keep writing to you, but your report has never come.

transliteration: Da-ri-ku-da il5-qé 7 ½ GÍN
translation: Darikuda received 7 1/2 shekels.

transliteration: Ša-hi-iš-ha-lá-ga il5-qé 7 ½ GÍN ig-re-šu
translation: Shahishhalaga received 7 1/2 shekels, his hire.

transliteration: Du-za : il5-qé 7 ½ GÍN ig-re-šu
translation: Duza received 7 1/2 shekels, his hire.

transliteration: a-na ba-a-ba-tim ša e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni ih-da-ma KÙ.B iš-tí A-šur-ma-lik ša-ak-ší-da-nim
translation: Pay attention to the outstanding amounts which I left to you and make sure the silver reaches me with Ashur-malik.

transliteration: ú ṣú-ba-tí-a ša Lu-hu-sà-tí-a ih-da-ma a-Ha-nu pu-nu-a-ma lu-šé-ri-ib-šu-nu
translation: And pay attention to my textiles of Luhusaddia; turn to Hanu so that I may bring them in.

transliteration: 10 TÚG dIM-SIG5 ú-šé-ra-ba-am
translation: Adad-bani will bring in 10 textiles.

transliteration: ki-ma ṭup-pu-šu ša maš-ki ú SÍG.HI.A tal-pu-ta-ni té-er-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam
translation: Since you have written his tablet concerning skins and wool, let your report come to me.

transliteration: um-ma A-šùr-i-dí-ma ù A-a-ke-en6-ma a-na A-la1-hi-im qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus (says) Ashur-idi and Ayaken: speak to Alahum.

transliteration: a-šu-mì KÙ.B ša sà-am-ru-a-tim ší-bu-tim ni-im-hu-ur-ma um-ma né-nu-ma KÙ.B ša-qá-lam la i-mu-ú
translation: Concerning the silver of the nails, we approached the elders and (said) as follows: 'They refused to pay the silver'.

transliteration: a-té-er-tí-ku-nu A-la1-hi-um ip-la1-ah-ma KÙ.B ik-nu-uk-ma i-ra-mì-ni-šu ù-šé-bi-lam-ma
translation: Alahum feared your instructions and he sealed the silver and sent it personally.

transliteration: KÙ.B i-na E-lu-hu-ut a-šu-mì ILLAT-tí-BA ih-tí-li-iq
translation: The silver was lost in Eluhut on account of the caravan.

transliteration: bé-lu KÙ.B 7 ù 8 i-na pu-hu-ri-im it-bi-ú-ma a-wa-tám ù-ta-e-ru
translation: The owners of the silver, seven or eight (of them), rose in the assembly and replied.

translation: I here, for the grinding, must beg the whole city.

translation: Speak to Ilum-malak and Ashur-malik.

translation: The remainder of your textiles, 148 3/4 textiles, your textiles were cleared.

translation: They did not take my ropes and my pack-saddles from my merchandise.

translation: Thus Aššur-malik said: 'My father, seek!'

translation: Thus says Ashur-bel-shadu: to Ashur-malik, speak:

translation: Walia is bringing 53 minas of tin to you.

translation: I checked it here and it was short by 2 minas 10 shekels.

transliteration: mì-ša-al AN.NA ta-dí-in
translation: You gave half of the tin.

transliteration: mì-iš-lu-um i-ba-ší
translation: The half is available.

transliteration: KÙ.B-áp-kà iš-tí wa-ar-ki-ú-tim ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: I will send your silver to you with the next messengers.

translation: Seal the silver from the price of 100 textiles, the votive offerings of our father, which you are holding, and the price of 20 textiles that Itur-ili is holding, and send it with Walia to our father.

translation: Please, according to our father's instructions, send 40 minas of silver from our father's silver.

translation: Thus says Ashur-malik:

translation: Idi-Assur, your attorney, is satisfied with the remainder of his wages.

translation: He said: 'I have been told to take my food allowance.'

translation: Clear the outstanding claims of the gentleman and bring a clear report.

translation: The gentleman cheated and left without me.

transliteration: a-ma-kam ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu tù-kà-lá
translation: There you hold the tablet with his seal.

translation: I spent 1/2 mana of silver for the affairs of the son of Imdi-ilum.

transliteration: ta-da-nam lá i-mu-a
translation: He refuses to give it.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-tim 3 ší-be-e i-šu-šu
translation: He has three witnesses for this matter.

transliteration: 3 GÚ URUDU SIG5 ku-nu-ki-a Zu-zu-li DUMU Hi-ba na-áš-a-kum
translation: Zuzuli, son of Hiba, is bringing to you 3 talents of good copper under my seals.

translation: Of that, I gave him 1 shekel of silver and 1 mina of copper here.

translation: Give him 3 shekels of silver there.

transliteration: ší-tí URUDU iš-tí bar-ki-ú-tim ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
translation: The rest of the copper I will send to you with the next messengers.

translation: Alahum, son of Sukallia, is bringing you an abarnium-garment.

translation: Regarding the price of the house of the limmu-official, they have sealed the house.

translation: I keep going to your representatives and saying: 'Look, the limmu-official keeps sealing the house.'

translation: Thus they said: 'What should we do?'

translation: Whether it is 1 mina of silver or 2 minas of silver, let us take 8 minas of silver and let us pay.

translation: And tomorrow, let them take away our houses for interest.

translation: There is no one who can turn back the limmu-official.

transliteration: ù li-mu-um i-a-tí-ma i-ta-na-lá-kam
translation: And the limmu-official keeps coming to me.

translation: Since there is no one who will pay and silver is not available, we will wait and in two or three months we will sell the house.

translation: Please, as soon as you hear the tablet, take care and send the 8 minas of silver which you owe to the limmu-official of Sukallia.

translation: The limmu-official has harassed me and I go to your representatives five times in a month.

transliteration: a-ni mì-nam lá-dí-in
translation: Now, what shall I give?

translation: Azuza seized us against Ennam-Aššur.

translation: Thus said Azuza to Ennam-Aššur: "Return the working capital and go where you wish."

transliteration: TÚG ša da-ar-kà-ku-ni li-dí-am
translation: Let him deposit the garment that I have put on.

transliteration: ú ṭup-pu-um ša bé-ú-lá-tí-a lu ṭup-pí-ma
translation: And let the tablet of my working capital be my tablet.

translation: When Ashur-tab died, Shalim-ahum son of Tab-ili and Alahum son of Nur-Suen questioned Hanu son of Itur-ili.

translation: Thus they said: 'Where is the silver that Ashur-tab left?'

transliteration: um-ma Ha-nu DUMU I-tur4-DINGIR-ma mì-nam KÙ.B ta-za-na-kà-ra
translation: Thus Hanu son of Itur-ili said: 'Why do you keep claiming the silver?'

transliteration: 35 ma-na KÙ.B ša A-šur-/DÙG i-É-tí-ni : i-ba-ší
translation: 35 minas of silver of Ashur-tab is in our house.

transliteration: a-na-kam pá-né-e I-tur4-DINGIR iš-tí-a ša-ki-in
translation: Here, the presence of Itur-ili is established with me.

transliteration: um-ma šu-ut-/ma a-na a-bi4-kà ta-áš-pu-ur
translation: Thus he said: 'You wrote to your father.'

transliteration: a-ma-kam a-lam mu-ùh-ra-ma
translation: There, approach the City assembly!

transliteration: a-wi-lu-ú a-ni-ú-tum ší-bu-šu
translation: These men are his witnesses.

transliteration: ṭup-pu ša A-sur-DÙG i-ku-nu-ki-šu-nu kà-an-ku
translation: The tablets of Ashur-tab are sealed with their seals.

transliteration: šu-nu-ma be-el ší-ma-tim ú ša-zu-úz- tù šu-nu-ma
translation: They are the executors of the testament and the representatives.

transliteration: al-qé KÙ.B a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma i-a-tí
translation: I took the silver to my representatives.

transliteration: šé-bi4-lam KÙ.B e ta-ak-lá-ma
translation: Send the silver to me, do not withhold it.

transliteration: li-bi4 e im-ra-aṣ
translation: Lest my heart become grieved.

transliteration: a-na be-a-lim ta-dí-LAM
translation: You gave it for use.

transliteration: lu gi-mì-lu-um i-a-tí
translation: Let it be a favor for me.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.B a-na A-šùr-na-da a-na ni-qí-šu a-dí-in
translation: I gave 10 shekels of silver to Ashur-nada for his sacrifice.

transliteration: 1 GÍN KÙ.B a-na me-er-i-šu a-dí-in
translation: I gave 1 shekel of silver to his son.

transliteration: i-nu-mì a-na A-KI ki i-na li-mì-im DINGIR-šu-GAL i-li-ku-ni a-dí-šu-nu-tí
translation: When they went to the City during the eponymy of Ilushu-rabi, I gave (it) to them.

translation: Azuza, son of Ishtar-pilah, and Azuza, son of Ashur-malik, owe x 5 shekels of silver to Alahum and Gamalia.

translation: From the hamuštum-period of Ahu-qar, they shall add x shekels per month as interest.

transliteration: a-na Šu-Ku-bi4-im ù DINGIR-ba-ni qí-bi4-ma um-ma A-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: To Shu-Kubum and Ilu-bani speak, thus says Alahum.

transliteration: URUDU 35 ½ ma-na URUDU i-ṣé-ri-kà i-šu
translation: You owe 35 1/2 minas of copper.

transliteration: i-na Wa-ah-šu-ša-na šál-ma-am ša-qá-lam qá-bi4-a-tí
translation: In Wahshushana, you are promised to pay in full.

translation: From the hamushtum-period of Ikunum, you are promised to pay within 20 days.

translation: To this day, 25 hamushtum-periods have passed.

translation: Per month, you shall add 2 minas per talent as interest.

translation: I hold your certified tablet with your seal.

translation: To Assur-malik and Itur-ili speak, thus says Tahasali.

translation: Concerning Assur-tab about whom you wrote to me, I entrusted 221 kutānu-textiles and 7 donkeys, according to your instructions, to Shu-Ishtar son of Ili-ishtikal and Irma-Assur.

translation: I did not know that Assur-tab had died; since Takila came here, they have told me.

translation: The textiles which I entrusted were his, but as for those of Alahum, I do not know.

translation: We spoke to him strongly regarding the 3 shekels of silver.

transliteration: šu-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.B tal-qé ta-er-šu-um
translation: If you took the 5 shekels of silver, return it to him.

transliteration: i-na pí-im ù li-ša-nim ta-li-ik-ma a-ni-qí-a ta-ta-ba-al
translation: You went in person and you are carrying away my jewelry.

transliteration: ù a-ni a-na li-mì-im ša-wi-ri-a áš-ta-qal
translation: And now I have paid my rings to the eponym.

transliteration: tù-dí-tí a-na ší-pá-tim a-tí-dí-ma uš-ta-na-áb-lá-kà-at-ma
translation: I have given my toggle-pin for the wool and he keeps making me come back and forth.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er ip-ri-a ù-ṣa-áb
translation: He is adding to my rations.

transliteration: GÉME ṭé-i-ta-am lá ni-šu
translation: We have no grinding maid.

transliteration: GÉME šé-ri-am
translation: Send me a maid.

transliteration: ú-ul té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma GÉME li-iš-ú-mu
translation: Either let your instructions come to me so that they can buy a maid.

transliteration: 12 ma-na KÙ.B ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša a-na A-šùr-DÙG A-mur-DINGIR i-du-nu-ma
translation: Amur-ili will give 12 minas of refined silver, its nishatu-tax added and its shadu'atu-tax paid, to Ashur-tab.

transliteration: KÙ.GI me-he-er-šu A-mur-DINGIR ša-bu

transliteration: A-lá-hi-im : qí-bi4-ma um-ma A-šùr-be-el-ša-du-e-ma

transliteration: um-ma a-ta-ma : né-ma-lam ú-ša-ar-ša-kà

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma : ú-lá ú-ba-šu

transliteration: pá-ni áš-ta-kán
translation: I have set my face (I am resolved).

transliteration: mì-ma a-nim i-na Za-al-pá i-na be-tí-kà ta-am-šu-ha-ni
translation: All this you have robbed me of in your house in Zalpa.

transliteration: i-na pá-ni-a pu-zu-ra : ta-ṣa-ba-at
translation: You are taking refuge from me.

transliteration: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša I-dí-/a-bi4-im a-na 2 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
translation: He shall pay within two months from the hamuštum-period of Iddi-abum.

transliteration: a-ma-sú Ta-ga-na-ba-ta ša-pá-ar-tum
translation: His maidservant Taganabata is the pledge.

transliteration: a-na Puzur2-A-šùr : qí-bi-ma um-ma Bu-zu-ta-a-ma
translation: Speak to Puzur-Ashur, thus says Buzutaya.

transliteration: na-áš-pé-er-ta-kà A-šur-ma-lik ú-ša-áš-me-ma : um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: I made Ashur-malik hear your message, and he said:

transliteration: ku-a-tí : lá i-de8-kà
translation: I do not know you.

transliteration: Puzur2-A-šùr šu-um-šu KÙ.B ha-bu-lá-ma ša-áp-ra-tí-šu ú-kà-al
translation: A certain Puzur-Ashur owes silver and I am holding his security.

transliteration: a-ma-kam iš-tí a-wi-li-kà at-wu-ú
translation: Discuss it there with your representatives.

transliteration: ú i-na KÙ.B ša li-bi-kà KÙ.B lá tù-ṣa-ha-ra-am
translation: And do not deduct silver from the silver which you owe.

transliteration: a-ma-lá a-wa-tí-ni : KÙ.B ur-ki-tí šé-bi-lam
translation: In accordance with our agreement, send me the later silver.

transliteration: KÙ.B ša DUMU Ì-lí-a lá té-zi-ib
translation: Do not leave the silver of the son of Iliya behind.

transliteration: a-ma-lá na-áš-pè-ra-tí-a ša a-na Kà-ni-iš ú-lá-pí-ta-ku-ni : e-pu-uš
translation: Proceed in accordance with the messages I wrote to you for Kanish.

transliteration: i-dí-in kà-ri-im ṭup-pá-am ša ša-ba-e a-na ITU.3.KAM Ma-lik-en-nam ú-ba-lam-ma kà-ru-um ú-ša-ha-az

transliteration: le-ru-ub-ma : ṭup-pè-e : li- ip-té-ú-ma ṭup-pì lá-al-qé

transliteration: a-na A-lá- hi -im qí-bi4-ma

transliteration: um-ma I-dí-dIM-ma
translation: Thus says Iddin-Adad:

transliteration: li-ba-kà i-de8- e
translation: You know.

translation: Since the silver has been sent with the merchant, I have sent the silver to you.

transliteration: um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.B 1 GÍN li-li-a-/kum
translation: I said as follows: "May one shekel of silver come to you."

transliteration: ší-ma-am ma-lá ta-áš-a-ma-ni mì-šu-um té-er-ta-kà lá i-/li-/kam
translation: Why has your report not come to me regarding as much merchandise as you bought for me?

transliteration: lu KÙ.B a-na pá-ni-a a-na Wa-ah-šu-ša-na li-im-hu-ra-ni

transliteration: té-er-tí i-na Ša-lá-/tù-a-ar wa-ar-ki a-li-ki a-ni-ú-tim
translation: My report is in Shalatuwar after these travelers.

transliteration: a-na A-la1-hi-im ù Šu-Ku-bi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma I-dí-dIM

transliteration: 4 ma-na.TA KÙ.B ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
translation: For each 4 minas of silver, its nishatum-tax is added and its šadu'utu-tax is paid.

transliteration: a-na-ku ù En-na-a-ni nu-šé-ba-la-ku-nu-tí

translation: Thus says Ashur-tab.

translation: I have settled the matters of Ugawa and Shikmadu.

transliteration: 2 ½ ma-na KÙ.B a-na ni-qí KÙ.B al-qé
translation: I took 2 1/2 minas of silver for the silver sacrifice.

transliteration: 2 ma-na KÙ.B a-na 2 ITU.KAM i-ša-qú-lu
translation: They will pay 2 minas of silver in 2 months.

translation: They will pay 5 (or 6) minas of silver in 10 hamushtu-periods.

translation: They will pay 3 minas of silver in 20 hamushtu-periods.

translation: If they do not pay, his tablet remains his tablet with the sons of Ukita.

translation: Alāhum has a claim of 1 mana of refined silver and 2 manas of amurrum-silver against Haluli and Taruhnum.

translation: 10 shekels of silver are owed by Anuli the scribe.

translation: The colony of Zalpa handed us over for these matters, and we gave our testimony before the daggers of Ashur.

translation: Shalim-Ashur seized us against Ashur-nada.

transliteration: um-ma Ša-lim-A-šùr-ma
translation: Thus says Shalim-Ashur:

translation: The colony of Timelkia sent 1/3 mana and 5 shekels of silver to the colony of Hurama.

transliteration: a-tù-nu tal-qé-a-šu
translation: You took it.

transliteration: KÙ.B šé-ṣí-a-nim-ma
translation: Produce the silver.

translation: I myself brought 200 textiles and 6 talents of tin with my caravan.

translation: Later, Ashur-tab passed through Ninassa and took 4 talents of tin under the seal of Alahum and their packing, and he brought them to Purushattum.

translation: He left 2 talents of tin for me.

translation: When Alahum came from the smuggling, Alahum brought him 5 talents of refined copper with his tin.

translation: I gave 21 minas as hire for the wagon and 32 1/2 minas into their hands.

translation: If they do not pay, they shall add interest according to the rule of the colony.

translation: Idnaya, son of Ataya, shall pay 5 minas of silver within one year.

translation: Alabum, son of Shu-Ti-MAS, shall pay 2 minas of silver within one year.

translation: Ashur-malik, son of Enna-Suen, and Puzur, son of Anum-ili, shall pay 2 minas and 1 shekel of silver within one year.

translation: Ashur-bel-awatim, son of Shu-Anim, shall pay 2 minas of silver within 20 hamishtums.

translation: Zupa, son of Elali, and Ili-ishtikal shall pay 2 5/6 minas and 4 1/2 shekels within 5 hamishtums.

translation: Shamash-bani, son of Puzur-Ishtar, shall pay 3 1/3 minas of silver within one year.

translation: Shamash-bani, son of Puzur-Ishtar, shall pay 2 minas and 8 shekels of silver within 20 hamishtums.

translation: Pilahaya, son of Ilpi-usur, shall pay 1 mina of silver within 20 hamishtums.

translation: Shu-Laban, son of Tab-Ashur, shall pay 5/6 mina of silver within 20 hamishtums.

transliteration: ba-tí-iq tal-qé
translation: You bought (it) cheaply.

transliteration: a-ma-kam Ri-mu-um iš-tí-kà li-iz-ku i -lu-qú- tim
translation: There, may Rimum settle (accounts) with you from the merchandise.

transliteration: 30 ma-na ni-ga-li ù ṣú-ha-ra-am a-na A-lá-hi-im DUMU A-mur-A-šur DUMU Ṭá-áb-a-hu : i-nu-mì a-na pá-ni : A-da-da áš-pu-ru-šu-ni : a-ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-šu-um
translation: I gave 30 minas of sickles and a servant to Alahum, son of Amur-Ashur, son of Tab-ahu, when I sent him to Adada for purchases.

translation: In the sack of my share, 1 1/2 minas of silver and 40 minas of fine copper are placed.

translation: Separately, x minas of copper for your food I gave to you.

translation: The merchant has a claim of 3 1/2 minas of refined silver against Garia, son of Shulabrat.

translation: From the hamuštum-period of Ilia, in the month Kuzallu, in the eponymy of Ikuppi-Ištar, he shall pay within one year.

translation: He holds as a pledge the houses of Shulabrat, which Enna-Suen, the attorney, sold.

translation: I seized his hem.

transliteration: a-na 1 ma-na KÙ.B a-na ar-nim i-ta-ad-nu-ni
translation: They have sentenced me to one mana of silver as a penalty.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša kà-ri-im áš-me-ma

transliteration: KÙ.B a-na hu-bu-ul a-bi4-šu ú-ša-sà-ah-ma

transliteration: li-mu-um uš-ta-am-ṭí-a-ni
translation: The limmu-official has treated me poorly.

transliteration: ù a-na mu-zi-zi-kà i-na ITU.1.KAM ha-am-ší-šu a-lá-ak-šu-nu-tí
translation: And I go to your representatives five times in one month.

transliteration: i-na pá-na i-li-ku-nim ša li-mì-im a-ší-ma ša-wi-ri-a a-dí-in
translation: Previously, those of the limmu-official came and I gave my bracelets.

transliteration: a-ma-kam ba-a-ba-tim ša e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni ih-da-ma
translation: Take care of the outstanding accounts that I left with you there.

transliteration: KÙ.B šé-ṣí-a-ma KÙ.B iš-tí A-šur-ma-lik ku-un-kà-nim
translation: Send out the silver and seal the silver with Ashur-malik.

transliteration: A-šur-ma-lik a-ma-kam lá i-sá-hu-ur
translation: Ashur-malik must not delay there.

transliteration: a-na Ú-ṣur-ša-A-šur qí-bi-ma a-hi a-ta
translation: Speak to Usur-sha-Ashur: You are my brother.

transliteration: ú a-ta KÙ.B ša li-bi4-kà ša-ak-ší-dam
translation: And you, have the silver which you owe reach me.

transliteration: a-na Šu-Ištar qí-bi4-ma
translation: Speak to Shu-Ishtar.

transliteration: a-wa-tí-kà ša a-na A-lá-hi-im ha-bu-lá-tí-ni ú-ga-me-er-ma
translation: I have settled your affairs for which you were indebted to Alahum.

transliteration: šu-ma lá ta-áš-qúl a-ma-lá ṭup-pì-kà pá-ni-im A-lá-hu-um i-šé-e-kà
translation: If you do not pay, Alahum will seek payment from you according to your previous tablet.

transliteration: KÙ.B-šu ù SÍG.HI.A ša li-bi4-kà a ša ki-ma A-lá-hi-im šu-qú-ul
translation: Pay his silver and the wool that you owe to the representatives of Alahum.

transliteration: šu-ma lá ta-áš-qú-ul a-ma-lá ṭup-pì-kà pá-ni-im a-šé-e-kà
translation: If you do not pay, I will seek payment from you according to your previous tablet.

transliteration: šu-ma be-lu-a a-tù-nu té-er-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam-ma úz-ni pì-tí-a
translation: If you are my lords, let your report come to me and inform me.

transliteration: A-lá-hu-um DUMU E-lá-lí a-na A-lá-hi-im DUMU Sú-ku-hi-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma : um-ma A-lá-hu-um-ma
translation: Alahum, son of Elali, seized us against Alahum, son of Sukuhi, and Alahum said as follows:

transliteration: mì-nam sí-ki : tù-kà-al be-ša-am
translation: Why do you hold my hem and property?

transliteration: um-ma A-lá-hu-um DUMU Sú-ku-hi-ma a-ki-li ṭù-pí-kà-ma ú-kà-al-kà
translation: Thus Alahum, son of Sukuhi, said: I hold you according to the mouth of your tablet.

transliteration: ṭù-pu-ú-a ha -am-ša-at 1 GÚ 9 ma-na KÙ.B a-ta-ah-ba-lá-ku-um
translation: My tablets are five; I owe you 1 talent and 9 minas of silver.

transliteration: 1 GÚ 9 ma-na KÙ.B ha-bu-lá-tí
translation: You owe 1 talent and 9 minas of silver.

transliteration: um-ma A-lá-hu-um DUMU E-lá-lí-ma ša ni-ìš A-limki ú ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al
translation: Thus Alahum, son of Elali, said: Let me hold that which you swore by the life of the City and the prince.

transliteration: um-ma A-lá-hu-um DUMU Sú-ku-hi-ma da-nu-nu-um da-ni-na
translation: Thus Alahum, son of Sukuhi, said: Strengthen the binding agreement.

transliteration: 10 GÍN KÙ.B ṭup-pu-um ha-ar-mu-um ša I-šar-A-šur iš-tí A-šur-re-ṣí DUMU Šu-li pá-qí-id
translation: A certified tablet of 10 shekels of silver belonging to Ishar-Ashur is entrusted with Ashur-re'si, son of Shuli.

transliteration: 42 ma-na URUDU iš-tí Nu-um-hi
translation: 42 minas of copper are with Numhi.

transliteration: 46 ma-na URUDU iš-tí Šu-mì-a-bi4-a
translation: 46 minas of copper are with Shumia-abia.

transliteration: 35 ma-na URUDU SIG5 iš-tí Puzur2-BE-Ištar
translation: 35 minas of good copper are with Puzur-beli-Ishtar.

transliteration: 26 ma-na URUDU iš-tí Ha-dí-ni
translation: 26 minas of copper are with Hadini.

transliteration: 12 ma-na URUDU iš-tí Zi-ba-a-li
translation: 12 minas of copper are with Zibali.

transliteration: a-na A-limki a-ṣé-er I-ku-pì-a DUMU Il5-ba-ni ú šu-a-tí a-Ú-lá-ma ú-bi4-il5
translation: He brought it to the City, to Ikupia son of Il-bani and to him himself.

transliteration: i-na 1 ma-na KÙ.B ša A-šur-bé-el-ša-du-e ša Ištar-ma-lá-ak ub-lá-ni : ni-is-ni-iq-šu-ma 1 GÍN im-ṭí 1 ½ GÍN da-tám
translation: From 1 mina of silver of Ashur-bel-shadue, which Ishtar-malak brought, we checked it and 1 shekel was missing and 1 1/2 shekels was the road-tax.

transliteration: 3 ma-na ni-ga-li ù 1 GÍN KÙ.B i-na Té-ga-ra-ma : a-šar lu-qú-tum : ib-ší-ú a-dí-in
translation: I gave 3 manas of sickles and 1 shekel of silver in Tegarama where the goods were.

transliteration: a-wa-tim : ša I-dí-Ištar ú-ga!(ša)-me-er-ma 17 ma-na KÙ.B a-na 5 ha-am-ša-tim : i-ša-qal
translation: I have settled the affairs of Iddin-Ishtar; he will pay 17 minas of silver in 5 hamuštum-periods.

transliteration: 1 ANŠE a-hi ša I-dí-Ištar-ma ú sá-hu-du-ú šu-a-ú-tum-ma a-na Pu-ru-uš-ha-tim ú-bu-lu-nim-ma ú ša ki-ma šu-a-tí KÙ.B ú-ša-bu-ni
translation: They are bringing 1 donkey of my brother, which belongs to Iddin-Ishtar, and those sahudu-garments to Purushhattum, and his representatives will satisfy me with the silver.

transliteration: šu-ma KÙ.B ma-lá u4-me-šu lá ú-ša-bi4-ú-ni KÙ.B a-ta-ba-al-ma ú ṭup-pu-šu ṭup-pu-šu-ma
translation: If they do not satisfy me with the silver by his due date, I will take away the silver, and his tablet remains his tablet.

transliteration: ṭup-pá-am ša hu-bu-ul A-šur-ANDUL šu-ba-al-ki-ta-ma KÙ.B ú ṣí-ba-sú : zi-im-ra-ma
translation: Transfer the tablet of the debt of Ashur-andul, and set aside the silver and its interest.

transliteration: a-ṣé-er : Lá-ba-na-da A-lá-hi-im A-šur-ANDUL ú um-me-a-na-am ša ta-ša-qá-lá-ni šu-up-ra-ma a-wa-sú li-ig-mu-ru
translation: Write to Labanada, Alahum, Ashur-andul, and the creditor whom you are paying, so that they may settle his affair.

transliteration: té-er-tí i-lá-kà a-ša-me-ma
translation: My report will come and I will hear.

transliteration: ú KÙ.B 10 ma-na il5-qé
translation: And he took 10 minas of silver.

transliteration: ú-za-kà a-pá-tí
translation: I will inform you.

transliteration: ù a-na-ku AN.NA-kà a-na Pu-ru-uš-ha-tim ú-šé-ra-áb-ma a-na KÙ.B ú-ta-ar-ma
translation: And I will bring your tin into Purušhaddum and turn it into silver.

transliteration: A-šùr-be-el-SA.TU-e a-ṭá-ra-da-kum
translation: I will send Aššur-bēl-šadû to you.

transliteration: a-bi4 a-ta té-er-tí áb-kà-ma
translation: You are my father, send me my report.

transliteration: ù lá-at-bi4-a-ma lá-tal-kam a-na-kam lá sà-ah-ra-ku
translation: And I will get up and come; I am not delayed here.

transliteration: KÙ.B i-qá-qá-ad šál-me-šu-nu ra-ki-is
translation: The silver is bound to the person of the most solvent among them.

transliteration: URUDU ù KÙ.B a-na ṣé-er Puzur4-Ištar DUMU Da-dí-a i-tù-ar
translation: The copper and silver shall revert to Puzur-Ištar, son of Dadia.

transliteration: 30 ma-na URUDU SIG5 Puzur4-Ištar a-na ITU.1.KAM a-na Ma-num-ki-e-ni-a ša ki-ma DAM.GÀR-ri-im i-ša-qal
translation: Puzur-Ištar shall pay 30 minas of good copper in one month to Mannum-ki-enia who acts as the merchant.

transliteration: a-wi-lá-tum i-li-kà-nim-ma
translation: The women came here.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-la1-hi-im ù Kur-ub-Ištar qí-bi4-ma
translation: Thus says Ashur-idi: say to Alahum and Kurub-Ishtar.

transliteration: 1 TÚG šu-ru-um a-na A-šur-na-da A-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku e-zi-ib
translation: I left 1 black textile for Ashur-nada and Ashur-taklaku.

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.B i-a-am a-na 2 ma-na A-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku i-dí
translation: Ashur-taklaku deposited 1 mina of my silver for 2 minas.

transliteration: šu-ma a-hu-a-tù-nu!(DÍ) ih-da KÙ.B qá-tí ma-lá É kà-ri-im za-am-ru-ma lá-áp-tù té-er-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam
translation: If you are my brothers, take care! Let your report come to me regarding as much of my share of silver as is collected and recorded in the office of the colony.

transliteration: TÚG-tí-a a-ni-ú-tim a-qá-tí-a i-ta-dí-a
translation: Deposit these textiles of mine for my share.

transliteration: a-na A-lá-hi-im qí-bi4-ma 8 1/3 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.B a-na ṣí-ib-tim i-lá-kà-kum
translation: Say to Alahum: 8 1/3 minas 4 shekels of silver are accruing interest for you.

transliteration: Be-lúm-ba-ni a-na Lá-qé-pì-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma Be-lúm-ba-ni-ma a-na Lá-qé-pì-im-ma
translation: Belum-bani seized us against La-qepum and Belum-bani spoke to La-qepum as follows:

transliteration: a-na-kam : ṭup-pu ša a-bi4-ni pá-at-ru!-ma
translation: Here the tablets of our fathers are released.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-um ša hu-bu-ul a-bi4-kà : lá-šu
translation: The tablet of your father's debt does not exist.

transliteration: šu-ma : ma-ma-an i-na a-hi-a : ṭup-pá-am i-ta-áb-lá-kum ba-lá-tù-a lá ta-ma-kà-ar
translation: If anyone among my brothers brings you the tablet, do not negotiate without me.

transliteration: a-ma-kam KÙ.B ší-im AN.NA-šu ú 2 TÚG ša a-pá-ni A-lá-hi-im DUMU Nu-ur-ZU ú-šé-bi-lu lu ú-ku-ul-tí ANŠE KÙ.B tí-šu-ma
translation: There you have silver, whether the price of his tin and 2 textiles that they sent in the presence of Alahum, son of Nur-Ishtar, or for fodder for the donkey.

transliteration: 5 u4-mì-im lá i-sà-hu-ur ṭur4-da-šu
translation: He should not tarry for five days; send him here.

transliteration: ta-ah-sí-is-tù ša 23 2/3 ma-na 1/3 GÍN KÙ.B ša Šu-Ku-bu-um ú Bu-zu-ta-a i-na ba-áb-tí-kà il5-qé-ú-ni-ma ú-šé-bi-lu-ni-ku-ma i-li-bi4 ṭup-pu-šu ša A-šùr-DÙG e-li-a-ma KÙ.B a-na ša A-šur-DÙG iš-ta-ak-nu
translation: Memorandum regarding 23 2/3 minas and 1/3 shekel of silver which Shu-Kubum and Buzutaya took from your outstanding balance and sent to you; it appeared in the record of Ashur-tab and they have placed the silver into that of Ashur-tab.

transliteration: um-ma ša ki-ma A-šur-/DÙG-ma KÙ.B a-num A-šur-DÙG a-na A-lá-hi-im ú-šé-bi4-il5
translation: Thus say the representatives of Ashur-tab: "Ashur-tab sent this silver to Alahum."

transliteration: a-na ṣa-hu-ru-tim ša ke-na-tim iš-ta-ak-/nu-ni-a-/tí ú pá-ha-ra-am lá i-mu-ú
translation: They have made us look like liars and they refuse to gather.

transliteration: 78 TÚG ša pá-zu-ur-tim ŠÀ.BA 2 TÚG SIG5 ša-du-a-tum a-qá-tí-šu ni-dí-i
translation: Of the 78 textiles for smuggling, we placed 2 fine textiles as shadu'attu-tax into his hand.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-ṣú-lu-li-ma a-na A-šur-DÙG : qí-bi-ma
translation: Thus says Ashur-sululi: speak to Ashur-tab!

transliteration: a-šu-mì : ša A-la1-hi-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni 3 ITU.KAM ú-mu-a : ša ṭup-pí-a ha-ar-mì-im : lá i-li-ku
translation: Regarding Alahum, about whom you wrote to me, three months of the period of my certified tablet have not passed.

transliteration: KÙ.B ma-la1 ša-lá-ṭim ú-ša-qí-il5-šu-um
translation: I made him pay as much silver as was at his disposal.

transliteration: ší-tí KÙ.B 1 ma-na 5 1/6 GÍN KÙ.B a-na E-nu-Be-lim a-hi-a a-dí-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.B šu-qúl-ma : ṭup-pí šé-ṣí
translation: I gave the remainder of the silver, 1 mina 5 1/6 shekels, to Enu-Belum my brother, saying: 'Pay the silver and release my tablet!'

transliteration: a-hi a-ta i-bi-sà-e-a : lá ta-áš-ta-na-me-e
translation: You are my brother, do you not keep hearing of my losses?

transliteration: té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma KÙ.B a-na ša ki-ma ku-a-tí lá-áš-qú-ul-ma ṭup-pí a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí : dí-in
translation: Let your instructions come to me so that I may pay the silver to your representatives and give my tablet to my representatives.

transliteration: mì-iš-li-kà 6 ma-na KÙ.B a-na ṣí-ib-tim al-qé-/ma áš-qúl
translation: I took 6 minas of silver, your half, at interest and I paid it.

transliteration: a-da-an-ma a-ša-pá-ra-/kum
translation: I will give it and write to you.

transliteration: 2 GÍN KÙ.B a-na DINGIR-šu-ra-bí ša ṭup-pá-am : na-áš-a-/ku-ni dì-in
translation: Give 2 shekels of silver to Ilshu-rabi who is bringing the tablet to you.

transliteration: 11 TÚG ša A-ki-dí-e A-lá-hu-um il5-qé
translation: Alāhum took 11 Akkadian textiles.

transliteration: 16 TÚG šu-ru-tim 14 TÚG ša A-ki-dí-e 1 TÚG ku-ta-num ki-ma 2 TÚG lu-bu-ší 3 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša DINGIR-šu-ra-bi4 A-šùr-na-da il5-qé
translation: Aššur-nada took 16 šurūtu-textiles, 14 Akkadian textiles, 1 kutānu-textile instead of 2 garments, and 3 kutānu-textiles of Ilšu-rabi.

transliteration: MU.8.ŠÈ im-ta-al-a a-hu-ú-a a-tù-nu
translation: Eight years are completed; you are my brothers.

transliteration: ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-áš-me-a-ni 30 ma-na KÙ.B ku-un-kà-ma i-ba-tí-qí-im pá-nim-ma Ša-lim-be-lí ṭur4-da-nim
translation: As soon as you hear the tablet, seal 30 minas of silver and send Shalim-beli here with the first available caravan.

transliteration: 2 ma-na KÙ.B i-ṣé-er A-lá-bi4-im DUMU Šu-Tí-bar iš-tù ha-muš-tim ša dUTU-ba- ni ú Lá-qé-ep DUMU Ga-tí-im a- 7 ha-am-ša-/tim i-ša-qal
translation: 2 minas of silver are charged against Alabi, son of Shu-Tibar; he shall pay in 7 hamushtums from the hamushtum of Shamash-bani and Laqep, son of Gatim.

transliteration: 1 ma-na KÙ.B ú 23 ma-na URUDU SIG5 i-ṣé-er A-lá-bi4-im DUMU Šu-Tí-bar Puzur4-A-na qá-ta-tum iš-tù ha-muš-tim ša Lá-qé-ep ú dUTU-ba-ni a-3 ha-am-ša-tí i-ša-qal
translation: 1 mina of silver and 23 minas of fine copper are charged against Alabi, son of Shu-Tibar; Puzur-Ana is the guarantor; he shall pay in 3 hamushtums from the hamushtum of Laqep and Shamash-bani.

transliteration: 1 ½ ma-na KÙ.B i-ṣé-er A-šùr-iš-tí-kál DUMU A-šur-SIPA iš-tù ha-muš-tim ša A-ni-nim ú Im-dí-DINGIR a-na 4 ha-am-ša-tí i-ša-qal
translation: 1 1/2 minas of silver are charged against Ashur-ishti-kal, son of Ashur-sipa; he shall pay in 4 hamushtums from the hamushtum of Anninum and Imdi-ilum.

transliteration: ma-tí-ma : ša-du-a-tám lá ú-ša-dí-ú-ni-a-tí
translation: They have never made us pay the export duty.

transliteration: i-nu-ma kà-ra-am nu-šé-da ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma i-pá-ni-a-ma šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: When we inform the colony, you wrote to me: 'Send (it) to me personally.'

transliteration: lu ší-bé-e i-ba-áb a-bu-lim a-lu-qú-tí-kà ša-li-ṭim ša a-na A-šùr-DÙG i-šé-pì-šu ta-dí-nu ta-áš-ku-un lu a-Ta-ha-ší-li ta-áš-ku-un ṭup-pè-e ša ší-be-kà da-ni-in
translation: Whether you have placed witnesses at the city gate concerning your authorized goods which you gave to Ashur-tab for his caravan, or whether you have placed (them) against Tahashili, strengthen the tablets of your witnesses.

transliteration: um-ma ša ki-ma A-šur-DÙG-ma KÙ.B ma-lá ta-lá-qé-a-ni le-qé-a-ma : da-na-at-ni ṭup-pá-ku-nu : lu ni-ih-ri-im-ma me-er-ú a-wi-lim li-iš-e-ú-ku-nu
translation: Thus say the representatives of Ashur-tab: 'Take as much silver as you will take; let us seal your tablet (as) our valid (document), and let the gentleman's sons seek you out.'

transliteration: a-pu-tum a-ma-kam ṭup-pé-e-a ha-ru-mu-tim pí-tí-e-ma bi-ri-šu-nu-ma
translation: Please, open my certified tablets there and select among them.

transliteration: ma-ma-an ša i-na DAM.GÀR-ri-a wa-áš-bu ṣa-ba-sú-ma KÙ.B ú ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-il5-ma šé-bi-lam
translation: Seize anyone who stays with my agents, make him pay the silver and its interest, and send it to me.

transliteration: a-šar ta-dá-gu5-lu-ma lá-qá-a : KÙ.B i-ba-ší-ú i-na ṣí-ba-tim ma-lá : ta-le-e-ú ku-bu-us-ma KÙ.B le-qé
translation: Wherever you look and there is silver to be taken, cancel as much of the interest as you can and take the silver.

transliteration: 16 ma-na KÙ.B ša A-lá-ha-am DUMU A-de8-lá-at a-ší-a-ma-tí tù-šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: You (pl.) sent to me the 16 minas of silver for the purchases of Alahum, son of Adelat.

transliteration: KÙ.B-áp-kà i-ku-nu-ki-kà a-dí ta-lá-kà-ni i-ba-ší
translation: Your silver is under your seals until you come.

transliteration: 3 ma-na KÙ.B a-na Šu-Ku-bi-im ù i-a-tí ù a-ha-ma 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.B i-a-tí dIM-re-ṣí ha-bu-lá-am
translation: Adad-reṣi owes 3 minas of silver to Šu-Kubum and me, and separately 1 mina 15 shekels of silver to me.

transliteration: ṣa-ba-sú-ma KÙ.B ša-áš-qí-il5-šu
translation: Seize him and make him pay the silver!

transliteration: ù Šu-Ku-bu-um i-li-kam-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.B 1 ma-na LÁ 5 GÍN šu-qúl
translation: And Šu-Kubum came here and he said: 'Pay the silver, 1 mina minus 5 shekels!'

transliteration: ù 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.B ša a-ha-ma ha-bu-lá-ku-ni um-ma šu-ut-ma mì-ma ú-lá ha-bu-lá-ku
translation: And as for the 1 mina 15 shekels of silver which I owe separately, he said: 'I do not owe anything!'

transliteration: a-na Šu-Nu-nu qí-bi4-ma
translation: To Shu-Nunu speak:

transliteration: 5 GÍN KÙ.B ša a-šu-mì-kà a-na En-na-nim DUMU A-zu-ta áš-qú-lu a-ma-kam a-ta ù A-šur-be-el-ša-du TÚG.HI.A iš-tí-in ša-ak-sà-am a-na li-tab-ší-a ša-ma-nim-ma a-na Pu-ru-uš-ha-tim šé-bi4-lá-nim
translation: As for the 5 shekels of silver which I paid on your account to Ennanim son of Azuta, you and Ashur-bel-shadu buy one šakṣu-garment there for me to wear and send it to Purushathum.

transliteration: a-ta a-ma-kam hu-ta-sí-is-ma ṭup-pí-kà a-šar té-zi-bu té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma ṭup-pì-kà a-na-ku a-na-kam lu né-e
translation: You, there, remind yourself where you left your tablets; let your report come to me so that I may seek out your tablets here.

transliteration: a-dí KÙ.B-pì-kà la1 ru-a-qí-im A-šùr-DÙG a-na Tí-me-el-ki-a i-la1-ak-ma
translation: So that your silver does not get delayed, Ashur-tab is going to Timelkiya.

transliteration: a-ma-la1 me-eh-ri-im ša Tí-me-el-ki-a-i-im ša ta-dí-nu-šu-ni KÙ.B ša lá-qá-im i-la1-qé
translation: According to the copies of the Timelkiyan which you gave him, he will take the silver that is to be taken.

transliteration: a-na i-dí-i ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu A-šur-DÙG a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-kà i-ta-na-dí-nu
translation: On account of this, Ashur-tab will give the tablet under his seal to your merchant.

transliteration: ú KÙ.B-áp-kà ma-la1 iš-tí DAM.GÀR-ri-kà ú-ša-áš-qú-lu lu nu-šé-bi4-la1-ku-um
